listings.rawTitle: The Rich Rejuvenation Trio Day Cream 1 piece
listings.description: Three formulas, one goal: visibly smoother, plumper, and more radiant skin. The Rich Rejuvenation Trio combines three intensely nourishing Augustinus Bader must-haves into a luxurious ritual for the face and eye area. The trio specifically targets visible signs of aging and helps promote a firmer, more lifted complexion. The Elixir, a highly concentrated treatment, serves as the first step, followed by The Rich Eye Cream for the delicate eye area and the iconic The Rich Cream for intense hydration and a supple, plump feel. At the heart of the formulas are TFC8®, Trigger Factor Complex TFC™, and Advanced TFC8®—proprietary technologies developed by Professor Augustinus Bader that support the skin’s natural renewal processes and optimize the effectiveness of the respective skincare formulas. The set contains:The Rich Cream – 50 mlThe Rich Eye Cream – 15 mlThe Elixir – 5 ml

listings.rawTitle: OUD SUPERMASSIVE Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Oud Supermassive reveals an unapologetically bold interpretation of the mythical ingredient. From the very first notes, oud takes center stage, enveloped in olibanum and supple leather. Its powerful character is illuminated by a delicate hint of osmanthus, peach, passion fruit, bringing a subtle, almost solar brightness. In the base, tobacco extends the warmth of the sacred wood, leaving a deep, sensual, and lingering trail on the skin. A personal vision of oud , one that bridges cultures and contrasts, merging ancestral depth with contemporary freshness. A new way of creating, where opposites collide to reveal perfect harmony. Oud Supermassive is a co-creation between Arnaud Poulain and Julien Rasquinet.Top notes: Mandarine, Bergamot, CardamomHeart notes: Peach, Osmanthus, Passion FruitBase notes: Tobacco, Oud, Leather, Olibanum

listings.rawTitle: VANILLE SUPERMASSIVE Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: This intense, hazy vanilla extract plunges us deep into the mysteries of the abyss and universe. The gravitational force of spices carries patchouli and white musk essences in its wake. A constellation of woody notes then appears, revealing the solar aura of majestic, incandescent vanilla. Top notes: Bergamot, ElemiHeart notes: Cinnamon, Fir balsam, LabdanumBase notes: Patchouli, Vanilla, Caramel, Ambroxan, White Musks

listings.rawTitle: Oud for Grace Eau de Parfum Unisex 90 ml
listings.description: A modern, timeless oud composition designed to balance confidence and presence. At its core, precious smoky woods and sacred oud, anchored in depth, with edge. Oud with presence. Oud for those who move differently. A flash of bergamot cuts through, followed by a touch of vanilla for contrast. Praline adds a layer of subtle addiction, bringing warmth and tension. Urban. Timeless. Long-lasting. Where science meets sensation. A formula tested to trigger confidence and elevate perception. Notes: Vanilla, Praline, Bergamot, Black Pepper, Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Guaiacwood, Oud.

listings.rawTitle: Pacific Rock Swell Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Pacific Rock Swell is a fragrance of power and depth, where mineral freshness meets sun-warmed woods and the clarity of the sea air blends with the depth of the ocean. It opens with a vibrant burst of bergamot and cardamom, carried by the aromatic sharpness of clary sage. The fragrance evokes the crisp air carried by a rising swell as it gains strength along Australia’s rugged coastline. At its heart, seaweed lends a darker, textured depth. It blends with geranium, mimosa, and fir balsam to create a multi-layered composition that captures the vibrant energy of the ocean: salty, vibrant, and constantly in motion. As the fragrance unfolds, a warm note emerges from beneath the surface. Patchouli and Australian sandalwood form a rich, grounding base, while ambergris and moss leave a mineral-rich, radiant trail that lingers on the skin. Powerful, intense, and deeply captivating, Pacific Rock Swell transforms the spirit of the ocean into a fragrance—a wave of energy shaped by light, wind, and water. Born from the untamed beauty of the Australian coast, it captures the moment just before the waves break, when the ocean gathers strength and light dances across its surface.

listings.rawTitle: BROSSE LARGE N01 - AUBERGINE Hairbrushes 1 piece
listings.description: The universal brush in a large size naturally cares for your hair. This keratin-rich boar bristle hair brush draws the sebum out of your hair and distributes it evenly throughout the lengths. Moisturized from root to tip, your hair stays shiny for longer. By using this boar bristle hair brush daily, you will rid your hair and scalp of impurities and cut your shampooing frequency in half. Made from 100% boar bristles, the fibers of the Universal Hair Care Brush are made of keratin, which offers a natural solution to care for your hair. In addition to nourishing and moisturizing your hair, this naturally occurring protein ensures that there is no static electricity when brushing. Hand-placed in an irregular pattern on a flexible rubber base, the boar bristles are designed to penetrate your hair and thoroughly detangle it. The other advantage: they give your scalp a regenerating massage.

listings.rawTitle: BROSSE LARGE N02 - AUBERGINE Hairbrushes 1 piece
listings.description: Hairbrush in large size made of nylon and wild boar bristles. Rich in keratin, the hair brush’s boar bristles deeply moisturize the hair fiber from the tips to the roots. By enveloping the hair cuticles, they strengthen and protect them against external aggressions, leaving them even more shiny. The nylon fibers of this nylon and boar bristle hair brush make it easy to brush your hair, whether it's fine or thick. Neither too soft nor too stiff, the flexibility of the nylon bristles has been carefully designed to work through all hair types. Whether normal, thick, straight or soft hair, the Essential is the nylon and boar bristle hair brush you need in your everyday routine. Used in the morning, it effectively detangles and styles the hair. At night, it thoroughly rids the hair of impurities, allowing the scalp to breathe.

listings.rawTitle: BROSSE LARGE N03 - AUBERGINE Hairbrushes 1 piece
listings.description: Combining natural boar and synthetic nylon fibers, the Essential Soft Hair Brush in large size is the everyday hair brush for sensitive hair. The boar bristles naturally moisturize the entire length of your hair, leaving it with a brilliant shine. The keratin in the follicles of the boar bristles coats the hair cuticles and instantly revitalizes the locks, while the soft nylon fibers ensure gentle detangling. The ball-tipped nylon bristles of this hair brush gently massage the scalp: ideal for stimulating microcirculation without damaging it! This boar bristle and nylon brush is suitable for all hair types. Whether your hair is straight or soft, using the Essential Soft Hair Brush in your morning routine will leave your hair impeccably detangled and styled. Using this nylon and boar bristle hair brush in your evening routine will deeply clean, detoxify and regenerate the hair, ridding it of all the impurities that have built up during the day.

listings.rawTitle: BROSSE LARGE N04 - AUBERGINE Hairbrushes 1 piece
listings.description: The soft, evenly-distributed nylon fibers of the Miracle Brush in large size offer a deep daily massage that’s as soothing as it is invigorating. These soft, massaging fibers have the advantage of stimulating blood circulation in your scalp while promoting hair growth. The result: perfectly nourished hair at the root, protected and left looking healthy like never before. This vegan hair brush can be used on dry hair like any other traditional brush, but it is also very effective on wet or damp hair. It improves the effect of treatments and helps nourishing creams or hair masks to penetrate better.

listings.rawTitle: Decision 42 Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: The question at the heart of the original Decision Eau de Parfum is centred on a bolt of lightning – will it destroy the juniper tree upon which it has inflicted its electric energy, or prompt it to seek a deeper, more enduring life? In Decision 42, Quentin Bisch makes the scenario even more urgent. With a staggering 42% concentration, the composition now features a sharper evocation of the lightning, thanks to the use of Neroli, Cardamom and Cinnamon. The Juniper has been combined with Javanol, Patchouli and Rectified Pine Tar to make it darker, smokier, and more far-reaching. Finally, the base of the scent has been rendered more life-affirming with the addition of Vanilla and Labdanum. These grandiose elements combine to make perfume’s existential exploration even more piercing and insightful. Top notes: Pink Pepper, Bergamot, Cardamom, Neroli, CinnamonHeart notes: Frankincense, Juniper, Myrrh, Sandalwood, Rectified Pine TarBase notes: Patchouli, Cedarwood, Vanilla, Labdanum

listings.rawTitle: Spice Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Spice- Personal offers a quiet pause even in the busiest of places. Suede-like Saffron, aromatic Allspice and sweet Cinnamon Sugar are suspended with Skin Musks for a soft and warm cloud of spice dust. “The inspiration for Spice comes from a surreal collage of elements from my early childhood. Having grown up in an Armenian household in Kuwait, I was exposed to a unique combination of tastes, scents and environments. The days were dry, dusty and hot. A terracotta and sand-colored haze covered everything the eye could see. Dry and exotic spices embedded every dish on our dinner table. These spices were contrasted and made even more decadent with dripping sweet sugars all over our desserts. This mosaic of the senses is what I wanted to capture in a bottle!” – Vicken Arslanian, Re-Founder Top notes: Saffron, AllspiceHeart notes: Cinnamon Sugar, Condensed MilkBase notes: Helvetolide, Ambroxan Fragrance with Subtle Intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Orchidée Vanille Eau de Parfum Women 75 ml
listings.description: This Orchidee Vanille Eau de Parfum by Van Cleef & Arpels is a floral fragrance. It opens with top notes of orange, lychee, dark chocolate, and bitter almond before settling into a floral heart of Bulgarian rose and violet. The base notes of cedar wood, white musk, and tonka bean leave a lasting memory.

listings.rawTitle: Bois Doré Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: This Bois Dore Eau de Parfum by Van Cleef & Arpels features top notes of spicy black pepper and various minerals fused with a heart of nutty almond, cedarwood, and tobacco. Base notes of tonka bean, teakwood and a touch of white musk ends the perfume for a tantalizing elixir.

listings.rawTitle: Neroli Amara Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: At the beginning, Néroli Amara seems to exude the invigorating freshness and impression of a cologne on the skin. A radiant accord of sun-kissed citrus aromas enters into an invigorating, subtly spicy dialogue with pink pepper and noble cypress wood. Top and heart notes blend harmoniously and then reveal the true character as well as the infinitely multifaceted floral opulence of the creation. For the finale, the eau de parfum reveals the wonderful vision of its creator come true. The sensual scent of orange blossom - warm, sweet and intoxicating - embraces and seduces the senses like a gentle breeze, reminiscent of the warmth and delight of the Mediterranean spring sun.

listings.rawTitle: Santal Blanc Eau de Parfum Women 75 ml
listings.description: The multi-faceted fragrance brings the delicate facets of sandalwood to full fruition to exude a uniquely pure, white materiality. White as purity. White like softness. White like the perfect balance. That is why the iconic bottle of the "Collection Extraordinaire" is presented for the first time in immaculate white to reflect the perfection of the olfactory structure. The fragrance is a composition with tangy mandarin, sandalwood and fig milk. A hint of musk, plus powdery violet and deliciously almondy tonka bean characterize Santal Blanc's velvety-soft, sensory-enveloping finish.

listings.rawTitle: Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: This Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum by Van Cleef & Arpels is a woody fragrance for women and men. It features the scent of burning wood, opening with a date accord and leading to an intoxicating heart of incense and oud accord. White musks and vanilla bean leave a lingering trail that’s warm and addictive.

listings.rawTitle: Bois d'Amande Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: This Bois D'Amande Eau de Parfum by Van Cleef & Arpels is a Oriental Woody fragrance. Top notes of lemon and almond entice the senses, while cedarwood, amber and vanilla shine through from the base.

listings.rawTitle: Orchid Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: This Van Cleef & Arpels Orchid Leather Eau de Parfum is an amber spicy fragrance for women and men launched in 2021. A new olfactory territory and a unique interpretation of leather. Combining the two botanical ingredients cistus and vanilla, brought forth by the precious orchid, the impressive fragrance has a leathery character, enveloped by spicy cardamom, sweet plum and woody nuances of incense, vetiver and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Moonlight Rose Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: For the perfume of Van Cleef & Arpels was selected a particularly rare and luxurious rose: the Taif rose. The result is an extraordinary and elegant composition of diverse aromas that emphasize the fragrance of this unique rose. The honeyed, fruity accents combine with spicy pink pepper and chypre notes of oakmoss and patchouli. Van Cleef & Arpels perfume Moonlight Rose makes the rose appear in a completely new light and enchants in a unique way.

listings.rawTitle: Body Elixir Liquid 20 Stück x 10 ml
listings.description: Body Elixir is our first liquid beauty supplement to be taken orally. Combining different selected plants allows to easily eliminate toxins from our body. Body Elixir also helps with the sensation of tired, heavy legs that have a tendency to retain water. This complex uses 8 active ingredients including green tea which is an excellent diuretic, Birch for its draining, remineralizing and revitalizing properties and Witch Hazel, used for its benefits on the circulatory system, which helps to regain a sensation of light legs.A blend of probiotics, birch, and green tea, which all contribute to the elimination of toxins in the body. listings.rawTitle: Jojobaöl Body Oil 150 ml
listings.description: Organic virgin jojoba oil from Saint Charles is gently cold-pressed and comes from controlled organic cultivation. The evergreen jojoba bush grows primarily along dry river courses in Central America. Virgin jojoba oil, which comes from the seeds that contain up to 50 percent oil, has been used in cosmetics and skin care for some time. Jojoba oil is non-greasy and is quickly absorbed by the skin, making it smooth and supple. Jojoba oil also contains a lot of provitamin A and vitamin E.

listings.rawTitle: Mandelöl Body Oil 150 ml
listings.description: Almond oil organic by Saint Charles is gently cold pressed and certified organic. The almond tree grows up to 10 metres high and belongs to the rose family. The almond oil is extracted from the ripe nuts of the almond tree by cold pressing. In addition to a high proportion of monounsaturated fatty acids and linoleic acid (omega-6 fatty acid), it is rich in vitamin E and vitamin B. Almond oil has been part of folk medicine for centuries and was already used for medicinal cosmetics in ancient times. In addition to external use, it is also popular in the kitchen as an alternative to olive oil. Saint Charles Organic Almond Oil is grown in Spain and gently cold pressed in a regional oil mill.

listings.rawTitle: Mundziehöl Oral Care 150 ml
listings.description: Saint Charles Mouth Oil is a proven formula from the Saint Charles pharmacy. It consists of the gently cold-pressed vegetable oils sesame oil, coconut oil and black cumin oil, as well as a special blend of 100 percent naturally pure essential oils. All of them are certified organic. The blend of essential oils is based on the proven Five Heroes blend.

listings.rawTitle: Capsules No 5- Fatburner Tablets, Pills & Capsules 60 piece
listings.description: Supports weight regulation as part of a low-calorie diet. In addition, zinc contributes to a normal energy metabolism and a normal metabolism of macronutrients and the B vitamins contribute to a normal energy metabolism and to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. Additionally with valuable amino acids and plant extracts from green tea, bitter orange, ginger, cayenne pepper and guarana.

listings.rawTitle: Capsules No 7 - Coenzym Q10 plus Tablets, Pills & Capsules 60 piece
listings.description: For active people to support heart and circulatory activities. Also ideal for athletes. With coenzyme Q10 and caterpillar fungus extract.

listings.rawTitle: Capsules No 11 - Hyaluronsäure plus Tablets, Pills & Capsules 60 piece
listings.description: Hyaluronic acid occurs naturally in the body, scavenges free radicals and binds moisture. The 100% vegetable, vegan capsules made from hyaluronic acid not only keep the skin elastic and prevent it from drying out, but also have a positive effect on the joints. Vitamin C contributes to normal collagen formation for normal bone function, normal cartilage function and normal function of the immune system. Zinc contributes to the maintenance of normal bones and to the normal function of the immune system. With pomegranate plant extracts.

listings.rawTitle: Vitamin D3 Liquid 10 ml
listings.description: Vitamin D is also called the sun vitamin. Although it can be formed through direct exposure to sunlight via the skin, the body's own synthesis decreases with age and can be negatively influenced by other factors. These include a possible deficiency due to frequent stays indoors, as well as an insufficient supply through food. Among other things, vitamin D contributes to the normal function of the immune system, normal blood calcium levels, the maintenance of normal bones, normal teeth and normal muscle function. Wheat germ oil is used as a carrier oil. Filled in a proven and protective pharmacist's brown glass bottle with pipette for exact dosage.

listings.rawTitle: Tee Tea 50 g
listings.description: Delicious and soothing chamomile tea from the Saint Charles pharmacy, with the scent of lavender and roses. Supplied in a fine glass container that will grace any kitchen and is also perfect as a gift.

listings.rawTitle: Propolisspray ohne Alkohol Liquid 30 ml
listings.description: Propolis is produced by bees to prevent foreign bodies, pathogens and germs from entering the hive. It consists of essential oils, resins, balsams and beeswax. The antibacterial, antiviral and fungicidal effect makes propolis an important protective substance - not only for bees. The spray contains no alcohol, so it is also ideal for children.

listings.rawTitle: Honigbärchen Healthy Snacks 70 g
listings.description: Honey good, healthy taste experience for young and old. With honey and 10 important vitamins. The best honeys give the Vitamin Bears their fine taste. Refined with cherry, passion fruit and lemon. A fruity-honey taste experience for young and old. Without colouring.

listings.rawTitle: Honig Healthy Snacks 250 g
listings.description: Honey and pollen are an unbeatable team. In combination with propolis and royal jelly, the most important bee products are united in one jar.

listings.rawTitle: Honig Healthy Snacks 200 g
listings.description: Propolis is obtained by bees from resins, balsams, essential oils and beeswax. Propolis has been valued as the 'antibiotic of the bees' since time immemorial. Due to its antibacterial, antiviral and fungicidal effect, propolis is an important protective substance with which the bees keep themselves germ-free - without any development of resistance. Honey with propolis, 100% natural and hand-stirred.

listings.rawTitle: Queen Essence Boosters & essences 100 ml
listings.description: Queen Essence by Omorivicza is the perfect preparation for optimal absorption of actives from serum and moisturiser. The formula contains snow mushroom for deep hydration, the biomimetic anti-pollution response of tomato stem cells and the plumping power of hyaluronic acid. The complexion is left smooth and supple, radiating a youthful glow.

listings.rawTitle: Silky (S)wipes Intimate Care 12 piece
listings.description: Silky (S)wipes have been developed specifically for the vulva with all aspects in mind, from material to pH and ingredients. Made with biodegradable organic bamboo and a super clean formulation, these silky soft intimate wipes are ideal for pre- and post-sex or whenever a quick clean-up is needed.

listings.rawTitle: STICK No2 - HIGHLIGHTER 4 g
listings.description: This highlighter stick adds a soft subtle shimmer to cheeks in an instant, setting highlights where they are desired. Its creamy texture ensures a smooth feel on the skin, while selected waxes and argan oil provide additional and lasting care. "A must-have - and so easy to use!" - Loni Baur, Founder.

listings.rawTitle: BROW GEL Eyebrow Gel 4 ml
listings.description: An intensely nourishing, transparent styling gel for a naturally perfect eyebrow look. The mix of moisturizing Panthenol, growth-promoting peptides and ProVitamin B5 ensures that the eyebrows are in top shape and the hair root is strengthened. "A good eyebrow gel gives the eyebrow a long-lasting perfect shape." - Loni Baur, Founder.

listings.rawTitle: LINER - NIGHT BLUE Eyeliner 4 ml
listings.description: This liquid eyeliner makes any liner look absolutely effortless. The liquid texture not only inspires with a rich blue color but also with a patented peptide ingredient that strengthens and protects the root of the eyelashes. The liner is also suitable for sensitive skin. Precise application is made a breeze with the narrow tapered applicator. "The eyeliner is an absolute eye-catcher." - Loni Baur, Founder.

listings.rawTitle: Wild Collagen Powder 200 g
listings.description: Wild Collagen provides easily digestible, highly bioavailable Type I hydrolysed collagen peptides. Sustainably sourced from free swimming white fish from the icy waters of the North Atlantic. With a neutral taste, it dissolves easily into hot or cold drinks, and is perfect to sprinkle on food, to effortlessly nourish from within. A real hero product for active lifestyles, fasting protocols and beauty rituals. Collagen is the most abundant protein in the body and is naturally found in skin, cartilage and bones. As we age collagen levels naturally decline which may affect mobility, skin elasticity and lead to visible signs of aging.

listings.rawTitle: 25% AHA + 2% BHA Exfoliant Peel Face Peeling 30 ml
listings.description: This liquid-gel peel glides over skin and immediately goes to work to address multiple signs of aging. AHA, a water-soluble exfoliant, addresses wrinkles, fine lines and rough, crepey texture. Oil-soluble BHA penetrates pores to unclog, refine and soothe. The result after rinsing? Hydrated, supple, ultra-glowy skin.This AHA BHA peel is suitable for all skin types. It’s ideal for advanced signs of aging, sun damage, severely clogged pores, or for anyone who simply wants to try an effective at-home peel.

listings.rawTitle: Smoothing Comb attachment Hair accessories 1 piece
listings.description: The T3 Smoothing Comb glides through the hair and distributes heat evenly to dry hair quickly while stretching and detangling. The air-permeable teeth are specially designed for curly and frizzy hair and direct the airflow to the strands to lengthen and smooth the hair. Only compatible with T3 AireLuxe hair dryers.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Eye Fix Eye Serum 10 ml
listings.description: De-puff, firm and rehydrate the delicate eye area with this highly targeted serum. The formula targets both the root cause and physical signs of stress-induced aging. With regular use the eye area appears noticeably revitalised, refreshed and more youthful.“Without realising, our eyes take on the stress our minds feel. Essential Eye Fix opens, refreshes and really brightens the eyes giving the appearance of a perfect night sleep!” - Annee de Mamiel, Founder.Chronic stress can show on your face. The hormone that your body releases when you feel stress, Cortisol, causes changes to the proteins in your skin which reduce its elasticity. This loss of elasticity can contribute to wrinkle formation and is compounded by stress impacting the skin’s ability to retain water, it impairs the stratum corneum’s barrier function leading to dehydration. The delicate eye area is particularly susceptible and additionally can be prone to under eye bags, characterized by swelling or puffiness beneath your eyelids. listings.rawTitle: Escentric 01 Eau de Toilette Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Escentric 01 celebrates the hyper-abstraction of Iso E Super. Iso E Super is a molecule that hovers close to the skin to create an indefinable aura around the wearer. Escentric 01 focuses on Iso E Super at 65% of the fragrance compound in an abbreviated formula designed to maximise the molecule's efflorescence. It contains lime peel, hedione (green jasmine bud), orris incense, balsamic notes, and fresh musk, producing a seriously lingering base note. Iso E Super does not exist in nature and was created in a laboratory at the IFF in 1973. Geza Schoen: "I wanted to create something unconventional, not too perfumistic, something for my friends who said they didn't like fragrance." This magic love potion inside this vessel presents a whole gamut of differences in how people experience it. A fragrance liberated from preconceptions of identity and form. Escentric 01 induces individuality and eschews boring fragrance fanfare.Top notes: Lime, Pink Pepper, AldehydesHeart notes: Orris, Hedione (green jasmine bud)Base notes: Iso E Super, Incense, Mastic, Muscone (Musk)

listings.rawTitle: Molecule 01 Eau de Toilette Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Molecule 01 consists of 100% Iso E Super, pure and singular. It combines with — almost caramelises with — your own smell to meld into a personal scent signature. Molecule 01 has been said to cause animal magnetism — a latter-day love potion. Geza Schoen used the beautifully mysterious and democratic aroma-molecule Iso E Super as the star of this juice. He felt it expressed everything a perfumer could want: radiance, tenacity, and power. "Iso E Super is one of those scents that makes you want to nestle into it. It's comforting and cocooning," says Geza Schoen. Molecule 01 has a marked intermittence. To the wearer, it seems to vanish and then re-appear. This is due to the way it sits with receptors in the olfactory system, only slowly releasing to make it easy for a new charge of the molecule on the receptors. Iso E Super does not exist in nature and was created in a laboratory at the IFF in 1973. "Molecule 01 is for the individual who might be a bit bored with fragrance and would prefer to radiate an aura. It's difficult to call a single aroma-chemical a fragrance — it's so much more personal," says Geza Schoen. Molecule 01 is a cult classic of today that remains as disruptive and avant-garde as the day it was first bottled.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric 02 Eau de Toilette Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Escentric 02 explores the many faces of perfume's most prized aroma-molecule. Escentric 02 is centred on the elusive power of nature-identical Ambroxan (13.5%), a sensual amber molecule with almost mineral smoothness, together with the aphrodisiac notes of green jasmine bud and a sparkling 'gin and tonic' accord, a hint of Almdudler, and "that specific smell you get when you unwrap a new Apple laptop". Geza Schoen describes the final effect as a "super long-lasting freshness into the drydown, with a subtle sensuality".Top notes: Almdudler, Juniper Berry, Mandarine, Lime, BergamotHeart notes: Ginger, Freesia, Clary Sage, Pink Pepper, Hedione (green jasmine bud), OrrisBase notes: Muscone (Musk), AMBROXAN™, Vetiver, Tonka

listings.rawTitle: Molecule 02 Eau de Toilette Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Molecule 02 consists of Ambroxan, pure and singular. Ambroxan is a crystal-chemical structure identical to the ambrox derived from ambergris. For centuries ambergris was perhaps the most prized ingredient in perfumery. It is a somewhat mysterious substance expelled by the cachalot or sperm whale, which only attains its fine scent after a long maturation floating in the ocean. Ambergris is rarely found these days, and the 'amber' in a modern fragrance will be a lab-created equivalent of some of the aroma-molecules that make up its scent. By far, the finest of these is the nature-identical molecule, Ambroxan. Ambergris was always valued for its refinement as well as its sensuality, and this quality persists in Ambroxan. Ambroxan was isolated from plant sources in 1950. The maximum percentage that can be dissolved in a fragrance compound is 13.5%. Any more, and it begins to crystallise out of the solution. Most fragrances with 'amber' contain 1-2%. Molecule 02 is 100% Ambroxan in alcohol and a little water. This is best described as a fresh, almost mineral smoothness, which subtly expands to envelop you in olfactive layers of sensuous, sparkling molecules.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric 03 Eau de Toilette Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Escentric 03 honours Vetiveryl Acetate, a natural root + synthetic hybrid. Vetiver's alluringly sensual aromatic flavour goes beyond composition. This accord has a clean crispness with a sharp effervescent quality that plays beautifully in the landscape of skin scents. Picture the scene. A gentle river runs through green plains. On the horizon, a plump orange sun rises behind a set of fluffy clouds. This isn't a pastoral painting or a picture-perfect seen ripped from the pages of a literary classic. This is an olfactory memory of Escentric 03. Vetiveryl Acetate could be described as a hybrid molecule, half-synthetic, half-natural. It is a fraction of vetiver oil distilled from the roots of an Indian grass, which is then 'crossed' with acetic acid to remove the bitter and leathery aspects of the root. Escentric 03 focuses on Vetiveryl Acetate in a formula that pays tribute to the three roots used in perfumery: vetiver, ginger and orris. "I wanted Escentric 03 to bring out the scent impressions of these roots and show how they harmonise with each other," says Geza Schoen.Top notes: Green Notes, Lime, Mandarine, Pink Pepper, Black Pepper, GingerHeart notes: Freesia, Rose, Hedione (green jasmine bud), Jasmin, Orris, Cinnamon, TonkaBase notes: Vetiver, Sandalwood, Iso E Super, Leather, Muscone (Musk), Amber, Costus

listings.rawTitle: Molecule 03 Eau de Toilette Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Molecule 03 consists of Vetiveryl Acetate, pure and singular. Vetiveryl Acetate could be described as a hybrid molecule, half-synthetic, half-natural. It is a fraction of vetiver oil distilled from the roots of an Indian grass, which is then 'crossed' with acetic acid to remove the bitter and leathery aspects of the root. In India, vetiver essential was an ingredient of ancient perfume and was referred to as 'the oil of tranquillity'. Vetiver is known to reduce anxiety and promote mental clarity through the comforting and venturing powers of its aura. For Molecule 03, Geza put a modernist spin on Vetiveryl Acetate; the refined vetiver note celebrated for its earthy-smokey facets and rich, enveloping nature. Think of uncut grass on a warm day, or envisage a forest muddled with warm balsamic undertones, and you'll have an idea of what vetiver smells like. "Acetylation brings out the grapefruit touch in vetiver, giving a more pronounced bitter-fresh top note," says Geza Schoen. The result is an elegant and refined molecule with vetiver's woody, slightly grassy character, but far smoother and softer.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric 04 Eau de Toilette Unisex 100 ml

This is a uniquely fresh interpretation of a sandalwood fragrance, fizzing with crisp, bitter top notes of pink grapefruit peel with an added zest of lime. listings.rawTitle: Molecule 04 Eau de Toilette Unisex 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Dia Man Eau de Parfum Men 100 ml
listings.description: Dia Man is a versatile chypre fragrance inspired by the natural wonders of the Ottoman and a prime example of stylish subtlety. A wind filled with the powerful notes of bitter orange and cardamom blows through the quiet streets of Muscat, where the vapors of royal incense and cistus labdanum dance incessantly. From the desert rises the scent of distant oases: fine peony, ylang-ylang and plum, deliciously candied in the light of an eternal sun, anchor their exquisite roundness on a bed of earthy, cocoa-like iris. Heavy with the aromas of dense and moist patchouli, dry green vetiver, warm leather and glorious amber, the base skillfully rounds out the vibrant daytime fragrance. Top notes: Labdanum, bitter orange, incense.Heart notes: Peony, ylang-ylang, iris.Base notes: Vetiver, leather, patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Reflection Man Eau de Parfum Men 100 ml
listings.description: Fresh, spicy and aromatic, Reflection Man embodies sophistication and elegance. The striking florality captures the seductive power of a strong man. Notes of patchouli and vetiver in combination with sensual woods underline the timeless signature of this masculine fragrance. Reflection for Man is an unmistakable and irresistible creation that takes elegance to the extreme. The top note is characterized by freshness and spiciness: A dried, aromatic sprig of rosemary interweaves with the honeyed reflections of bitter orange leaves and the wild, sparkling clarity of pink pepper. The heart is floral with neroli, jasmine blossom, leathery iris and lush ylang-ylang. In the base note, Virginia cedarwood and Haitian vetiver meet in a weave of soft, dried woods, while a silky accord of patchouli and sandalwood unfolds and settles. Top notes: rosemary, pink pepper, bitter orange leaves.Heart notes: neroli, iris, jasmine, ylang-ylang.Base notes: vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood, cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Epic Man Eau de Parfum Men 100 ml
listings.description: Epic Man is a woody, oriental fragrance that brings to life ancient stories of the long journey along the Silk Road from China to Arabia. Frankincense, cumin, cardamom, saffron and nutmeg come together in the rich top notes before being complemented by the beguiling scents of geranium and myrrh in the heart notes. The fascinating fragrance is rounded off with oud, sandalwood, patchouli, leather, incense, cedarwood and musk. The bottle was inspired by the rich green of the mineral jadeite, which is highly prized in the Orient for its mystical powers. The outer packaging is modeled on an antique Chinese travel case made of precious leather. Top notes: pink pepper, frankincense, cumin, cardamom, saffron, mace, nutmeg, myrtle.Heart notes: geranium, myrrh.Base notes: oud, sandalwood, patchouli, leather, incense, cedarwood, musk, castoreum.

listings.rawTitle: Epic Woman Eau de Parfum Women 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the legendary Silk Road, Epic Woman is a spicy oriental amber fragrance that blossoms in the mystical twilight between China and Arabia. Piquant sparks of pink pepper combine with the spicy warmth of cinnamon and cumin. A mystical and legendary rose shines in the heart note. It is intensified by lemony notes of geranium and heady jasmine, while tea adds a moist freshness. Incense unfolds on a base of iris, guaiac wood and patchouli, infused with dusty oud. Warm sandalwood, Babylonian amber, Madagascar vanilla and powerful musk envelop the creation with a golden shimmer. Top notes: cumin, cinnamon, pink pepper.Heart notes: damask rose, tea, geranium, jasmine.Base notes: agarwood, incense olibanum, patchouli, ambergris, sandalwood, guaiac wood, vanilla, orris root, musk.

listings.rawTitle: Honour Man Eau de Parfum Men 100 ml
listings.description: This spicy and woody fragrance invokes memories of the past. A filial elegy to the honour and memory of Madame Butterfly, this is a story of reconciliation. Honour Man is a spicy-woody fragrance with a classic composition. Honour Man (and Honour Woman) are dedicated to the tragic story of Madame Butterfly, the geisha Cio-Cio-San, who married an American and waited three years for his return. Both creations are inspired by the last act of the opera. The fragrance version for men was inspired by Madame Butterfly's son. The top note exudes a tingling sensation of black pepper, underscored by the vibrant aromas of pink pepper. Delicate, sophisticated aromas of rose geranium follow, meeting a dry, bright nutmeg and lemony notes of Madagascar elemi. The excitement fades, the emotions consolidate and the tension of the heart notes transform the fragrance with a woody accord of cedar and patchouli. It is rounded off with nutty vetiver and a honeyed base in which frankincense and tonka bean absolute shine. With its abundance of soothing and seductive spices, Honour Man describes the joy of a reunion after too many years of separation. Top notes: pink pepper, black pepper.Heart notes: geranium, elemi resin, nutmeg.Base notes: incense, vetiver, Virginia cedar, musk, tonka bean, patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Interlude Man Eau de Parfum Men 100 ml
listings.description: Interlude Man radiates pure masculinity. One that exudes calm, confidence and comfort, plenty of depth and warmth. After a spicy-fresh opening, an explosion of peppery spices with crisp oregano and fruity allspice berry, followed by gentle bergamot, the fragrance reveals a lush variety of aromas in the heart note - pure amber, vanilla, Somali opoponax and a hint of olibanum. The soft, spicy whole has a stimulating and calming effect at the same time. In the base, resins merge with dark, smoky woods, an attractive blend of oud, incense and sandalwood. Soft leather blends in harmoniously, revealing the pithy, distinctive side of the man. Smokiness overlays the balsamic warmth and plays with the feeling of comfort and physicality. An incessant duel of spices and balsams, Interlude Man is a magnificent example of harmony. Top notes: bergamot, oregano, allspice.Heart notes: ambergris, incense, labdanum (cistus), opoponax.Base notes: leather, oud, patchouli, sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Lineage Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: A song of salty incense, of mineral warmth and summer meditations, Lineage is the scent of travelling far from home to get closer to yourself. A spicy-green fragrance inspired by an exciting journey to the treasures of the Orient. The unique composition opens with fresh ginger notes, peppered with a hint of Peruvian pepper tree, Szechuan pepper and saffron, which are joined by mysterious aromas of frankincense, myrrh and fenugreek. The final olfactory explosion, however, is provided by an irresistible combination of labdanum, vetiver, benzoin and patchouli components. The texture changes from resinous to creamy, sparkling and effervescent, woody and balsamic. Top notes: ginger, Szechuan pepper, pink pepper, saffron.Heart notes: frankincense, fenugreek, myrrh.Base notes: frankincense, myrrh, vetiver, patchouli, benzoin heart, labdanum (citrus rose).

listings.rawTitle: Purpose Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Purpose is a fragrance of peace, the search for one's roots and the feeling of completeness. A spiritual awakening accompanied by mineral woods and stellar spicy sparks. In the top note, vibrant bergamot emerges like an icy breeze, captured by pink pepper, allspice berry and incense that unites past and future. The heart note appears with the wild and smoky scent of sand vetiver and an incorruptible rose, tamed by earthy papyrus and a gentle touch of sandalwood. The magical base is created by mysterious aromas such as acigalwood, mystical, saffron and suede. Top notes: bergamot, pink pepper, incense, allspice berry.Heart notes: rose, violet, sandalwood, papyrus.Base notes: saffron, suede, incense, acigalwood, mystical wood.

listings.rawTitle: Search Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Search is a citrusy unisex fragrance. It tells a captivating story of trials and conquests, of challenges overcome and goals achieved. It captures the essence of the virile energy of resilient minds who do not hesitate to confront their inner shadows in order to achieve their ideal fulfillment. A tribute to inner strength and determination for those who dare to explore their limits, who always strive to better themselves and discover new truths about themselves and the world around them. Wearing Search means embarking on a journey of self-discovery and allowing the perfume to become a companion on the path to realizing one's dreams and goals. The top note starts with a firework of lemon, lively and bright. Energizing lime notes appear and merge with bittersweet mandarin. In the heart note, dark woody notes merge into a sophisticated combination of green incense, elemi and black pepper, before an exquisite bouquet of juniper, spicy guaiac wood and vetiver form the perfect counterpart in the base. Top notes: lemon, lime, mandarin.Heart notes: incense, black pepper, elemi resin.Base notes: juniper, vetiver, guaiac wood.

listings.rawTitle: Guidance Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml

The notes blend harmoniously and subtly create a mysterious atmosphere. With its timeless elegance and aromatic complexity, Guidance is a companion in the search for inner truth and timeless beauty. The perfume reads like a poem, smells like an embrace and feels like a word of wisdom. The top note picks up with delicate pear, seductive hazelnut milk and incense pearls - reminiscent of a dreamlike oasis. In the heart note, the fragrance trail leads into a lush garden where osmanthus blossoms spread their intoxicating apricot aroma and lush jasmine and scarlet roses mingle with the leathery scent of saffron threads. Dark vanilla and skin-like sandalwood, ambery labdanum and royal amber make up the base note. Top notes: pear, incense, hazelnut.Heart notes: saffron, rose, jasmine, osmanthus.Base notes: labdanum (cistus), sandalwood, ambergris, vanilla.

In the top note, lively, bright lemon and energizing lime merge with bittersweet mandarin. The heart note appears with dark woody notes and a sophisticated combination of green incense, elemi and black pepper, before an exquisite bouquet of juniper, spicy guaiac wood and vetiver forms the perfect base. Guidance – a floral-woody unisex perfume. It completely reinterprets the fascinating Amouage triad of rose, incense and ambergris. The notes blend harmoniously and subtly create a mysterious atmosphere. With its timeless elegance and aromatic complexity, Guidance is a companion in the search for inner truth and timeless beauty. Lineage – a spicy-green unisex fragrance inspired by an exciting journey to the treasures of the Orient. The composition opens with fresh ginger notes, peppered with a hint of Peruvian pepper, Szechuan pepper and saffron, joined by mysterious aromas of frankincense, myrrh and fenugreek. The base is an irresistible combination of labdanum, vetiver, benzoin and patchouli components. The texture changes from resinous to creamy, sparkling and effervescent, woody and balsamic. Purpose – a spicy-woody-fresh unisex fragrance that is based on the journey of a spiritual awakening in search of one's roots. The top note combines notes of pink pepper, incense, allspice and bergamot, before rose, papyrus, vetiver and sandalwood meet in the heart note. The magical base is defined by mysterious aromas such as acigalwood, mystical, saffron and suede.

What makes Dia 40 Woman an "Exceptional Extrait"? A fragrance is usually a mix of a concentrate (containing fragrant oils) and an alcoholic base. Some fragrances can also contain a bit of water and additives like liquid UV filters, stabilizers or colourants. Therefore, fragrances with a higher fragrance concentration contain more perfume oils and less alcohol, and vice-versa. Usually, a higher perfume oil concentration means an increased performance of the fragrance (particularly longer lasting scent), but the impact of oil concentration is much more complex and varies depending on each formula. listings.description: Safran Secret recalls a mysterious adventure lived by Thibaud Crivelli during which he discovered a saffron field shrouded in a very thick fog. This deep, sensual composition is as captivating as enigmatic. It sees the brightness of a comforting saffron contrast with the opacity of warm and highly-diffusive woods.

listings.rawTitle: Lustre Perfume unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Lustre begins with a spark – a burst of effervescent cardamom that fills the air with spicy vitality. The illumination is extended and softened by orris – a uniquely powdery material that adds a sheen of luxurious romanticism, causing the composition to glow with a rich elegance. The white creaminess of the orris is furthered by sandalwood, whose smooth personality projects a sense of perpetual seamlessness. At the scent’s conclusion, a delectable vanilla embraces the whole with warm, lingering sophistication. Reflecting, emanating and adoring light, Lustre is an unashamedly poetic olfactory expression of the desire to make the present last until the end of time. Top notes: Cardamom, OrrisHeart notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, CedarwoodBase notes: Benzoin, Labdanum, Vanilla, Cypriol, Styrax, Tonka Bean, Myrrh

listings.rawTitle: Reasons Perfume unisex 100 ml
listings.description: When it first emerges, Reasons is somewhat unassuming: its hazelnut opening presents a warmth that is comforting but also perhaps surprisingly unostentatious. But within moments, the scent grows, taking on an increasingly grander form. The part-herbaceous, part-fruity personality of davana creates layer upon layer of depth and complexity. Finally, the smoky woodiness of palo santo introduces a grounding, resonant earthiness – rooting the whole in a sense of timeless, harmonious stability. With tremendous complexity and gravitas, Reasons conveys the idea that although the past may be gone, its effects live on forever, supporting the present, while giving it meaning, depth and value. Top notes: Cardamom, Hazelnut, Cinnamon, Schinus MolleHeart notes: Patchouli, Pine, Amber, Cypriol, DavanaBase notes: Benzoin, Cistus, Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Vetiver, Myrrh, Oakmoss, Musks, Palo Santo

listings.rawTitle: Regenerative 10B-EXO EGF Ampoule Ampoules 20 ml
listings.description: Regenerative 10B-EXO EGF Ampoule is a powerful, concentrated serum engineered to visibly restore, rejuvenate, and elevate the skin's appearance. Each set includes four 5ml vials, providing a 4-week intensive skin rejuvenation program. Each 5ml vial delivers 10 billion exosome vesicles extracted from Panax Ginseng Berry, Panax Ginseng Root, Centella Asiatica (Tiger Grass), Artemisia Annua (Sweet Wormwood), and Polygonum Fagopyrum (Buckwheat) for visibly restored, strengthened, and rejuvenated skin. These plant-derived exosomes remain stable even at temperatures up to 80°C (176°F) and do not require temperature-controlled, cold-chain storage, ensuring optimal performance. This powerful formulation is supercharged with 10 ppm of Korea-patented, stabilized EGF (sh-Oligopeptide-1), which supports visible skin renewal. This is the maximum concentration permitted by Korea’s Ministry of Food and Drug Safety. Unlike traditional EGF, which is prone to instability, the Korea-patented version in this formulation remains effective at temperatures up to 50°C (122°F). It is also vegan—synthetically produced using plant-derived starch, fermented yeast, and minerals, ensuring a sustainable and cruelty-free source.

listings.rawTitle: Purple Stain Extrait de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: Purple wine stains spread across the pages of an old leather journal, soaking into the paper with vivid, uneven marks. They tell of nights filled with life’s simple pleasures—laughter, quiet moments, and sparks of creativity. The journal, its edges softened by time, holds these memories on every page, capturing the joy and warmth of a life well-lived. Purple Stain opens with the warm spice of saffron, cinnamon, and nutmeg, brightened by the fresh zest of mandarin and bergamot. The heart is rich and indulgent, blending the radiant sweetness of orange blossom with creamy caramel and vanilla. As it settles, the base reveals a deep, smoky blend of oud, patchouli, and cypriol, softened by the resinous richness of cistus and the woody elegance of akigalawood. Velvety and bold, Purple Stain is a fragrance that lingers, leaving a powerful and unforgettable impression. Top notes: Saffron, Cinnamon Bark, Nutmeg, Ginger Extract, Mandarin, BergamotHeart notes: Orange Blossom, Caramel, Peru Balsam, VanillaBase notes: Akigalawood, Oud, Patchouli, Cypriol, Ambrofix, Cistus Concrete

listings.rawTitle: Black Mango Extrait de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: Sinking your teeth into a perfectly ripe mango, its golden juice drips down your fingers, flooding your senses with tropical sweetness—it’s one of life’s simplest, purest pleasures. For Jun Lim, founder of BTSO, mangoes are more than a fruit—they’re an obsession. That moment when you reach the core, where the sweetness fades into something raw and primal, yet you crave every last bite—that’s unforgettable. Black Mango captures that exact experience. Black Mango is the essence of indulgence and desire, bottled. It opens with the juicy sweetness of ripe mango and the zesty brightness of orange essential oil, instantly flooding your senses like biting into a perfectly ripe mango. As the scent deepens, the creamy richness of mango lassi blends with the warm, seductive notes of bourbon vanilla and resinous tolu, evoking a delicious, irresistible pull. But it doesn’t stop there—the base dives into the dark, smoky allure of oud, supple leather, earthy sandalwood, and spicy cypriol. Black Mango captures the raw, primal pleasure of savoring every last bite, down to the core—bold, addictive, and unforgettable. Top notes: Mango, Orange EoHeart notes: Mango Lassi, Bourbon Vanilla, Tolu Resinoid, SublimolideBase notes: Oud, Leather, Sandalwood, Cypriol

listings.rawTitle: Oud Candy Extrait de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: The smell of brown sugar melting on a warm stove is pure comfort—sweet, rich, and buttery. But when it starts to burn, it takes on a darker, smoky edge that’s impossible to ignore. Oud Candy captures this moment, where sweetness transforms into something bold and mysterious. It’s a fragrance that blends the warmth of indulgence with the depth of smoky, opulent notes—a perfect balance of light and dark. Oud Candy opens with the rich sweetness of melting brown sugar, creamy nuts, and warm milk, creating a cocoon of indulgence. As the scent evolves, soft white florals bring a touch of refinement. The base reveals its darker side, with smoky oud, saffron, and black woods layered over velvety caramel and vanilla. Hints of leather and oakmoss add a sultry, bold finish. Sweet yet smoky, comforting yet daring—Oud Candy is a deliciously addictive journey into the dark side of indulgence. Top notes: Brown Sugar, Candy, Nuts, MilkHeart notes: White FlowersBase notes: Oud, Saffron, Black Woods, Oakmoss, Vanilla, Caramel, Ambroxan, Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Leather

Most likely human but one cannot be sure. Looming at almost two meters tall he seems to take particular interest in the surrounding flora and fauna.Unaware of passersby, he spends his time picking and smelling flowers; only then he lets down his guard. A crack of a twig or the rustle of a leaf and he'll vanish back into the foliage.The locals call him Le Loyon, but the character calls himself Fantôme de Maules. The ghost of Maules.So who is Fantôme de Maules? A recluse, an outcast from society who has made a home in the forest? A survivalist preparing for the apocalypse? We will never know, because he doesn't want us to.And perhaps that's what makes Fantôme de Maules a character with such a riveting mystery. The modern world is alight with information and the shadows are shrinking. It is rare to come across someone who doesn't feel it is necessary to explain himself.

listings.rawTitle: Silphium Eau de Parfum Unisex 30 ml
listings.description: "Even if one just tastes it, at once arouses a humour throughout the body and has a very healthy aroma” - Pedanius Dioscorides, around year 70 BCSilphium (probably of the genus Ferula) was a plant that grew in the area of Cyrene, present day Libya, and was widely renowned as a spice, medicinal herb and perfume ingredient throughout the empires of the classical antiquity. It was praised by Greek philosophers and writers, as well as Roman emperors and cookbook authors.There were many attempts to cultivate Silphium, but they inevitably failed. It would only grow wild in a limited area of the north African coast. This, in combination with its qualities as seasoning and medicine made Silphium the most valuable spice in the world, outshining both saffron and cinnamon. The demand for Silphium eventually became so overwhelming that it was harvested to extinction, and the taste and smell of the once greatest spice in the world were lost in time.The rendition of this historical plant is created by researching surviving assumed relatives of Silphium, using aromachemicals (the molecular building blocks of scents) to create an accord that we feel represents what descriptions remains. This is set against a background of ancient incense, woods and leather.

listings.rawTitle: Moonmilk Eau de Parfum Unisex 30 ml
listings.description: “At night, the moon shines into the cave so brightly the light itself seems to take form” – Conrad Gessner, 1555The famous Swiss naturalist Conrad Gessner is considered the founder of modern zoology, but as a true 16th century scientist he was also: a prominent physician, botanist, linguist and—of course—spelunking adventurer.In his “Descriptio Montis Fracti sive Montis Pilati” from 1555, he chronicles his climb to the summit of Mount Pilatus, but we also get to follow him into the caves of the Alps. “At night, the moon shines into the cave so brightly the light itself seems to take form, like a mist. It gathers in the ceiling and makes the limestone stalactites glitter and gleam, dripping tears of white liquid into puddles on the rock floor that never dries. Moonmilk.”

listings.rawTitle: Mistpouffer Eau de Parfum Unisex 30 ml
listings.description: “Like trying to catch smoke with your bare hands” – Bem, Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban.A Mistpouffer is an unexplained natural sound, a sonic boom like distant cannon fire that seems to come out of the fog over large lakes or rivers. It has been recorded all over the world throughout history, and is the source of many legends. In Japan the phenomenon is called uminari meaning “cries from the sea”. In Connecticut, the Machimoodus state park gets its name from the native american name for the area, which means “place of bad noises”.Despite scientific attempts to understand the sounds (that can still be heard to this day), its source has still not been identified. Possible explanations include solar winds resonating in the atmosphere, underground earthquakes or gas bubbles being released from the deep. Others believe it is the work of extraterrestrial or subsurface civilisations. Early settlers in North America were told by the native Haudenosaunee Iroquois that the booms were the sound of the Great Spirit continuing his work of shapiqng the earth.Rendering this mystical water thunder as a fragrance was as elusive as the sound itself. Stora Skuggan spent four years and hundreds of iterations before finding the right balance between being distinctive and inexplainable. Foggy but not aquatic, smoky but not heavy. Natural, but in equal parts supernatural.

listings.rawTitle: Thumbsucker Eau de Parfum Unisex 30 ml
listings.description: “Me he shall suck” – Indra, King of GodsAn ancient king named Yuvanaswa had great wealth, good fortune and many wives. But no children, which he wanted more than anything. So the holy sage Bhrigu agreed to help prepare a magic potion for the king, and Yuvanaswa, being a very devout man, arranged a great ritual to please the gods. The ritual went on for several days, by the end Yuvanaswa was exhausted and very thirsty and as he stumbled around he came across a beautiful pitcher of water and drank all of it. PLOT TWIST. The pitcher was the magic potion prepared by the great sages, intended for the Queen.So, obviously, the king himself got pregnant. Luckily for Yuvanaswa, he was held in high regard by the holy powers. And when his pregnancy came to term, the seven great sages and even the king of Gods, Indra, joined him and cut a hole in the king’s thigh to deliver the baby boy. But a new problem arose; the king could not breastfeed his child. Indra slit his thumb, and because he was a god, his veins were filled with life-giving nectar instead of blood. So he let the boy suck his thumb and he proclaimed “Mandhata”, and that was the name of the new King, who would conquer all of the earth.And that’s why babies, being born with the memory of their divine ancestors, still suck their thumbs.

listings.description: Capri Dolce Vita is a celebration of paradise on earth, offering rare glimpses of this fabled corner of the world through the ages. Capri, a resort island dating back to the height of the Roman Empire, has long been an extraordinary destination full of ancient charm. Cherished by everyone, from the Swedish physician Axel Munthe – who recommended its clean air to his patients as a cure for bronchitis – to film director Jean-Luc Godard, who used it as the setting for his 1963 film Contempt. Literary icons, celebrities, poets and the jet set alike have all been drawn to Capri. The island boasts a rich Mediterranean spirit and style that encompasses a wealth of beauty, from gardens to villas to caves, and is embodied by the people walking in the lively Piazzetta, where cars are prohibited and the island’s playful attitude runs rampant.English edition.

listings.rawTitle: St. Tropez Soleil Coffee Table Books 1 piece
listings.description: St. Tropez Soleil guides the reader through its rich history and ever-evolving present. Featuring annual mainstays such as Les Bravades and the Les Voiles de Saint-Tropez as well as exclusive events like a Chanel fashion show at the quintessentially Tropezian Sénéquier café and the White Party at Nikki Beach, started by Naomi Campbell. But despite the constant changes, the spirit of St. Tropez remains the same and this volume is an ode to the unique joie de vivre and glamour that keeps everyone coming back.The legend of St. Tropez starts with a dog, a rooster and a martyr evolving into a destination beloved by movie stars, world-renowned artists, and distinguished writers. Located on the sparkling French Riviera, St. Tropez has been in the spotlight for more than half a century, attracting celebrities for its idyllic beaches and Mediterranean charm. This picturesque oasis has inspired a long list of notable writers from Françoise Sagan to Colette, as well as renowned artists like Paul Signac and Henri Matisse, and even filmmakers. However, St. Tropez wouldn't be the same without the iconic Brigitte Bardot, her films, lovers, and other famous couples, including Annabel and Bernard Buffet, as well as Bianca and Mick Jagger. English edition.

listings.rawTitle: Amalfi Coast Coffee Table Books 1 piece
listings.description: The Amalfi Coast embodies the pinnacle of the Italian dream. Tucked among lemon blossoms and bougainvillea, this stretch consists of 13 towns, accessible only by the Strada Statale 163 – a narrow, winding, cliffside road that, while challenging to traverse, offers unparalleled views. This magical strip connects the mountains to the Mediterranean Sea below, attracting aesthetes from around the world who return year after year to enjoy its quaint pebbled beaches, scenic hikes, perfect climate and legendary establishments. These include storied hotels and restaurants as well as cultural landmarks like the Cathedral in Amalfi and Villa Rufolo in Ravello. The Amalfi Coast has been graced by the presence of figures like Jacqueline Kennedy, John Steinbeck and Gore Vidal, whose influence endures in its vibrant culture. The region’s signature limoncello, produced and enjoyed locally, and its breathtaking villas and vistas, place the Amalfi Coast in a class of its own. English edition.

listings.rawTitle: Marrakech Flair Coffee Table Books 1 piece
listings.description: Marrakech is said to awaken all the senses. Whether it's seeing the intricate zellige tilework, smelling the spices sold in the souks, hearing the call to prayer from nearby mosques, touching the supple leather used to craft babouches (leather sandals), or tasting a flavorful tagine – Marrakech never fails to captivate. Located just west of the Atlas Mountains, the city has been inhabited by Berber farmers for centuries. It is often called the "Ochre City" because of the red sandstone buildings and the red city walls that now enclose the Medina, home to Jemaa el-Fnaa, one of the busiest squares in Africa. Marrakech is brimming with culture and has inspired visitors for decades. From Yves Saint Laurent to Talitha Getty, Winston Churchill to Mick Jagger, great icons have been drawn to the city. Yves Saint Laurent's intimate connection to Marrakech led to the opening of a museum dedicated to his legendary work. The annual Marrakech International Film Festival attracts prominent guests, while museums showcase Moroccan arts, photography, carpets and the Andalusian design that influences the city’s architecture. The historic La Mamounia hotel, opened in 1923, has hosted renowned guests such as Winston Churchill. Vanessa Branson’s El Fenn, a collection of traditional riads, offers a stunning boutique hotel experience. There are countless ways to immerse oneself in the culture of Marrakech, but perhaps the best place to start is with a simple glass of mint tea. English edition.

listings.rawTitle: Miami Beach Coffee Table Books 1 piece
listings.description: Considered by many to be the country’s most dynamic and sexiest city, Miami is more popular than ever. Yet, it’s a city that doesn’t merely change but evolves, never rewriting the past, only adding to its illustrious heritage. Miami Beach takes readers on a tour of this bold and wondrous metropolis. The chic Surf Club and vibrant Faena Hotel didn’t replace the emblematic Raleigh of the 1940s nor the Ritz Carlton of the 1950s; they complement them. Classics like Joe’s Stone Crab continue to serve their signature fare to sell-out crowds each night, as new establishments attract diners with name chefs. The iconic Art Deco architecture remains on full display, while the modern Herzog & de Meuron-designed Pérez Art Museum stands in stark contrast.Miami overflows with arts and culture year-round – from the international collections at The Bass to the street art of Wynwood Walls. Each December, the city is taken over by the global cultural elite for Art Basel Miami Beach, a fair that attracts over 80,000 visitors. Well-known for its nightlife, Miami places pleasure at the center of life. Yachts and recreational boats line the marinas, and lively beaches offer front-row seats to a parade of bronzed revelers. Rollerbladers and bikers cruise along its beachfront promenades. Miami has become the hub for everything chic, fiery, and colorful. English edition.

listings.rawTitle: Mykonos Muse Coffee Table Books 1 piece
listings.description: Located in the Cyclades and surrounded by the blue-green waters of the Aegean, sits whitewashed, windmill-strewn Mykonos, the "Island of the Winds." This ancient island, and those surrounding it – mythologized as the bodies of giants felled by Hercules in antiquity – are older than legend and have played host to countless cultures for more than a millennium. At forty square miles and with a population of only 10,000, the “Ibiza of Greece” has become prized for its gorgeous architecture, welcoming and open-minded locals and fantastic beaches. With names like "Paradise" and "Super Paradise," the sands of these shores have captured the imaginations and hearts of industry titans, artists, and party-goers from all over the globe, marking it as a stable cosmopolitan destination and a paramount haven on the jet-set circuit.This book chronicles the culture and society that has defined Mykonos over the past century – from its days as a hideout for luminaries and elites like Le Corbusier and Antonis Benakis, to its moment as a sanctuary for the gay community, to its current party scene – while indulging readers in the island's ruins and myths. English edition.

listings.rawTitle: Paris Chic Coffee Table Books 1 piece
listings.description: Paris is the city of chic – and as such, its innate style shines throughout the city, even in the simplest spaces. Quaint bistros, picturesque alleyways, artists’ studios and unique characters are elevated to a modern-day genre painting when set in Paris. From skateboarders to antiquarians, this volume is a glimpse into Parisian life, as if peering over the edge of the balcony at your own pied-a-terre. Collaboratively, author Alexandra Senes and photographer Oliver Pilcher open the doors to some of the most sophisticated homes in Paris, sharing an intimate portrait of various families. The quiet, daily moments of Parisian life are eternalized through Pilcher’s lens. Monuments don’t make a city; the people do. English edition.

listings.rawTitle: Italian Chic Coffee Table Books 1 piece
listings.description: Italy is synonymous with style and beauty in all aspects of life: the rich history of Rome, the Renaissance art of Florence, the graceful canals of Venice, the high fashion of Milan, the signature pasta alla bolognese of Bologna, the colorful architecture of Portofino and the sparkling blue waters of Capri and the Amalfi Coast, among many others. Daria Reina and Andrea Ferolla, sensitive and often nostalgic lovers of their home country, take readers on a journey through an Italian's Italy. This tour ventures beyond the well-trodden tourist paths to hidden side streets and off-the-grid locations, filled with the timeless details that define Italian style. Explore the Sassi cave dwellings carved into the mountainside of Matera; admire the red-orange walls characteristic of the Emilia-Romagna region; and examine the intricately carved birds at Sorrento's Grand Hotel Ambasciatori, so lifelike they seem ready to take flight. Reina and Ferolla invite readers to discover these special moments and places, revealing an intimate portrait of one of the world’s most treasured destinations. Ferolla’s classic illustrations add another layer of charm and personality to the experience. English edition.

listings.rawTitle: Barbie Coffee Table Books 1 piece
listings.description: This volume celebrates the sixty-fifth anniversary of Barbie, the world’s most iconic doll. Readers will explore not only Barbie’s rich history but also her unique magic: she is a doll through whom girls can project their own dreams and fantasies – whether as a doctor, rock star, paleontologist, Olympic gold medalist, Major League Baseball player, virologist, or ecologist.Created by Mattel co-founder Ruth Handler, a pioneering feminist visionary, Barbie defied the conventions of the 1950s by establishing a role for women beyond that of wife and mother. With an identity independent of family life, Barbie represented a modern and revolutionary figure, opening up imaginations to what both a doll – and a woman – could be.This book offers a decade-by-decade exploration of Barbie’s evolution from 1959 to today, filled with fascinating facts, insights and never-before-seen imagery. From Marilyn Monroe to Margot Robbie, fashion designers to first responders, Barbie offers a comprehensive look at this American cultural phenomenon. To date, more than a billion Barbie dolls with over 250 careers have been sold worldwide, offered in a diverse range of nationalities, ethnicities, and body types. English edition.

This strengthening formula increases the skin's elasticity, while rebuilding fibers for long-lasting results. Dermatologist tested.

listings.rawTitle: Restoration Oil Face Oil 5,5 ml
listings.description: A beautiful, delicate blend of nutrients, floral oils & extracts to help restore the skin’s youthful vitality. High tech natural actives and oils, from African Acmella, Lupin, Sea Fennel, Heart Seed Vine, Turmeric, Starflower, Rose Hip Seed & Evening Primrose, help firm, heal, hydrate and replenish, improving elasticity and reducing the appearance of fine lines for a healthy, radiant complexion.

listings.rawTitle: Renaissance 360 Day Cream 10 ml
listings.description: A 360 degree vitamin-rich day cream that combats the ageing process on all fronts. Skin elasticity is improved, fine lines reduced and hydration increased, while targeted actives reduce pigmentation and fade discolouration to even skin tone and brighten. Powerful nutrients nourish and enhance skin condition, supported by free-radical fighting anti-oxidants and a natural underlying SPF 8 to protect.

listings.rawTitle: Le Baume Foot Care 200 ml
listings.description: This Baume for sensitive feet is a creamy and original plant based formula with four main actions against drying up of the skin, heavy legs effect, nail degeneration and classic feet pain. “Feet are the foundation of our balance. Take time to massage them a few minutes a day in order to plump the fatty cushions” – Bastien Gonzalez, Founder.

listings.rawTitle: Unguent Nail Care 15 ml
listings.description: The care is a combination of essential oils and medicinal plants that softens, nourishes and protects nails and cuticles from daily stress.

listings.rawTitle: Luxury Horn Buffer Nail Care 1 piece
listings.description: The use of a buffer and polishing paste was passed down to Bastien Gonzalez, by his grand-mother, as a part of her «little secrets» to get shiny nails without using nail polish.

listings.rawTitle: Power Pocket Puff Make-up Sponge 1 piece
listings.description: With the Beautyblender Power Pocket Puff, make-up products in powder form can be applied quickly and easily. The two different applicator sides and its drop shape allow to work very precisely. Ideal for a perfect setting or a quick touch-up.

listings.rawTitle: Volupthe Hand cream & masks 25 ml
listings.description: The oil-free moisturizing and very light formula of VolupThé, contains a White Tea extract -with anti-oxidant properties- and amino acids which synthesize the collagen of the epidermis. A daily use of Graceful hands delight will help avoiding dry hands sensations and will maintain their suppleness and beauty. “VolupTHÉ, hand care, day after day brings immediate comfort and a soft feel to your hands. The use of the ointment Reverence nails and cuticles Bastien in addition give them a final touch Beauty,” – Bastien Gonzalez, Founder.

listings.rawTitle: Elemental Emulsion Face Cream 50 ml
listings.description: A must-have for all skin types, this lightweight oil-free emulsion can be used as a moisturiser, a moisture-booster or a serum. It contains marine extracts and hyaluronic acid to deliver long-lasting hydration while controlling shine on the surface.

listings.rawTitle: Firming Body Oil 100 ml
listings.description: Aromatic and invigorating, this firming body oil promotes the appearance of youthful elasticity. It also helps to reduce the appearance of stretch marks and leaves skin hydrated, soft and silky-smooth.

listings.rawTitle: Super Elixir Greens - Lemon and Ginger Powder 300 g
listings.description: WelleCo SUPER ELIXIR Greens is a dietary supplement designed by leading nutritional doctors using carefully formulated 45 ingredients derived from wholefoods. In easily absorbable powder form, it is designed to nourish the body daily at cellular level from the inside out. „Since taking 2 teaspoons a day and adopting a predominately plant-based diet, I have had more energy and felt healthier than ever. It has transformed my life.“ Elle Macpherson, Co-Founder.

listings.rawTitle: Deodorant Roll-On 50 ml
listings.description: An alcohol-free, roll-on alternative to Déodorant spray. Contains Zinc Ricinoleate, Wasabi extract, and a complementary blend of essential oils to reduce and mask unpleasant odour

listings.rawTitle: Remove Makeup Remover 60 ml
listings.description: A gentle eye-makeup dissolving oil enhanced with hydrating Tocopherol, and Blue Chamomile to soothe and calm the sensitive skin around the eyes.

listings.rawTitle: Déodorant Deodorant 50 ml
listings.description: An aluminium-free spray deodorant for men and women, formulated with Zinc Ricinoleate and a selection of essential oils to help reduce and mask underarm odour.

listings.rawTitle: Resurrection Aromatique Hand Wash Hand soap & scrub 500 ml
listings.description: A gentle formulation containing oils of Orange, Rosemary and Lavender to effectively cleanse the hands without drying them out.

listings.rawTitle: Lucent Facial Concentrate Hydrating Serum 60 ml
listings.description: A vitamin C-rich layering serum that soothes, replenishes and balances skin with its complex blend of anti-oxidant, lightly hydrating and conditioning ingredients.

listings.rawTitle: Herbal Deodorant 50 ml
listings.description: An aluminium-free, botanically based formulation containing Zinc Ricinoleate and a refreshing blend of essential oils to support poise under pressure.

listings.rawTitle: Damascan Rose Facial Treatment Anti-Aging Mask 25 ml
listings.description: A concentrated blend that delivers potent doses of Vitamins A and E, enhanced by ten precious plant extracts. Relieves, protects and replenishes parched skin.

listings.rawTitle: Reverence Aromatique Hand Wash Hand soap & scrub 500 ml
listings.description: An unorthodox aromatic blend with botanical extracts and finely milled Pumice, to gently cleanse, exfoliate, and leave the hands smooth, purified, and refreshed.

listings.rawTitle: Geranium Leaf Hydrating Body Treatment Body Oil 100 ml
listings.description: A concentrated hydrating oil boosted with anti-oxidant Vitamin E and skin-softening oils of Sweet Almond and Macadamia Nut.

listings.rawTitle: ACT 4 Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: The inspiration: Paris, 1976, 04.00 a.m., Chez Régine. In this scene, glamorous Parisian society ladies in haute couture dresses gather to celebrate the night. The neon mist of hairspray fills the powder room. Lipstick on crystal glasses from half-drunk Bellini cocktails. Another spray of perfume. You are adventurous and ready to dance the night away. There's a very special magic in the air... Notes:Leading role: Lactone of cis-jasmoneSupporting role: Patchouli, 30 years old

listings.rawTitle: MON VETIVER Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Charismatic and elegant — but surprising — this composition centers around the natural essence of Haitian vetiver. An unexpected Gin accord infuses it with freshness from Mexican lime and juniper essence. Accents of natural lavandin and gentian add even more interest, intensified by mysterious facets of cashmere wood and natural Indonesian patchouli. Mon Vetiver is built on Vetiver Haiti LMR, which is certified “For Life,” reducing environmental impact and supporting farming communities in Haiti. "I imagined a perfume with a modern elegance, built on a Vetiver and Gin accord. An encounter of character, with woody and aromatic accents." - Bruno Jovanovic, Perfumer

listings.rawTitle: THE MUSC Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: At once fresh, honeyed, and warm, The Musc is a subtle blend of captivating scents. It opens with red ginger from Laos and natural lavandin grosso from France. Natural and sustainable beeswax absolute brings a creamy sweetness to the heart, paired with a pure note of Nirvanolide musk. Australia’s natural sandalwood punctuates the blend with warm, woody tones. Replanted 20 years ago, Australia’s Sandalwood Spicatum provides Aboriginal communities with protection and sustainability for their land. "I imagined this fragrance as a cloud of enveloping and comforting musk. A delicious musk blended with red ginger, lavender, a radiant floral heart and soft, woody tones of a sublime sandalwood album from Australia." – Calice Becker, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: THE MUSC Extrait de Parfum Unisex 30 ml
listings.description: The Musc Extrait reinterprets the captivating signature of the Eau de Parfum in a nocturnal and carnal register. More spicy, more ambery and more daring, the fragrance unveils a new sensuality and a rare intensity, thanks to a concentration twice that of the Eau de Parfum.​ “In this extremely concentrated version of The Musc, I envisioned a profoundly carnal embrace. Musc ignites upon contact with blazing spices. Its trail grows more animalic, exalted by an overdose of Ambrofix™. Its caress becomes bolder, sculpted in the shadowed swirls of sandalwood and vetiver. A quintessence of desire.” – Calice Becker, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: THE MUSC Laundry Detergent 1000 ml
listings.description: Handcrafted in Provence using a traditional recipe, this highly concentrated, delicately scented detergent cares for your delicate clothes (wool, cashmere, silk...). Ideal for both machine and hand washing, it nourishes the fibres and leaves your clothes soft, supple and sparkling clean thanks to the action of biodegradable plant oils. Approximately 25 washes.

listings.rawTitle: DIVINE VANILLE Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Divine Vanille, is a tribute to Vanilla absolute, sustainably produced of Madagascar. Mysterious, suave, deep, carnal … simply irresistible. Natural Tonka Bean and benzoin enhance the soft, balmy and addictive facets of Vanilla. A blend of natural Cinnamon bark and sensual leathery tones of natural Osmanthus reveal rich facets of blond Tobacco and dried fruits. An innovative fraction of natural Cedarwood and Patchouli brings a creamy woody structure highlighted with silky musks, wrapping the fragrance with a delicate luminous veil. “This perfume is a celebration of Vanilla Absolute from Madagascar. I love it for its depth, its sensuality, its elegance and its addiction. I wanted to transcribe its soft, spicy and carnal facets, all infused with mystery.” - Olivier Pescheux, perfumer.
