listings.rawTitle: BOIS IMPERIAL Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Freshly crushed and spicy Thai Basil leaves meet the sparkling peppery and grapefruit facets of Nepalese Timut Pepper absolute. A brilliant combination that contrasts perfectly with the bold woody signature of the fragrance. A green, rich and earthy Haitian Vetiver oil echoes with Georgywood – an exclusive molecule with powerful cedarwood tones. This vibrating woody association is illuminated by the sophisticated floralcy of Petalia. Majestic Akigalawood truly signs the fragrance. This exclusive natural ingredient is upcycled from Patchouli through a biotechnology process. Its unique spicy-woody character is enhanced by a rich Indonesian Patchouli oil and a powerful, sustainable note of Ambrofix. "I created this fragrance around a precious and extraordinary wood: Akigalawood. Adorned with fresh spices, it is a great woody note made of contrasts, between patchouli and Thai Basil." – Quentin Bisch, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: BOIS IMPERIAL Extrait de Parfum Unisex 30 ml
listings.description: Explore the nocturnal side of Bois Impérial. Created as a quintessential version of the original fragrance, Bois Impérial Extrait takes you to the nocturnal side of the perfume. Darker, richer, stronger, it reveals a new sensuality and a rare intensity with twice the concentration of the Eau de Parfum. An absolute of seduction. "I created this fragrance around a precious and extraordinary wood: Akigalawood. Adorned with fresh spices, it is a great woody note made of contrasts, between patchouli and Thai Basil." – Quentin Bisch, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: FIG INFUSION Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the light of a sunny day in the south of France, Nathalie Lorson has composed an optimistic and reassuring fragrance. The top notes, a larger than life fig, is illuminated by a duo of juicy citrus mandarin and clementine. The floral heart, composed of freesia and orange blossom, meets the aromatic breath of Sri Lankan black tea. Finally, an enveloping wood accord, between the softness of Virginian cedarwood and the creaminess of sandalwood, provides comfort and refinement to the signature The voluptuous benzoin reinforces this cocooning accord with its balmy effects. "I imagined a luminous fragrance full of joy and pleasure. The reminiscent smell of an afternoon dreaming in the orchard, comfortably installed under the fig trees." – Nathalie Lorson, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: PATCHOULI MANIA Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the deep and sensual notes of patchouli, Fabrice Pellegrin has composed a fragrance with sensual and mysterious lines. At the opening, the fresh, gourmand and aromatic notes of davana and green hazelnut blends with the spicy woody note of coriander seed. The warm, gourmand heart offers an addictive dose of cocoa, balanced with the deep, woody notes of clearwood® and tea. Finally, the woody, warm and earthy base reveals a mysterious patchouli in harmony with the sensuality and roundness of vetiver and cetalox®, for a deep and bewitching trail. "I imagined a sensual patchouli, at once addictive, deep and mysterious. The composition finds a balance between the richness of patchouli and the powdery sweetness of cocoa." - Fabrice Pellegrin, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: NEROLI BOTANICA Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: The orange blossom, that white bud with a thousand subtle nuances, is at the heart of the creation and inspiration of master-perfumer Anne Flipo. Spicy and vibrant at opening, the fragrance burst with notes of curcuma leaf & ginger studded with a duo of pink and black peppers. Gloriously enhanced with neroli and Sambac jasmine, the orange blossom unleashes all its floral strength. Its solar and voluptuous facets blends with the green & velvety woody base notes of vetiver & sandalwood, both labelled with the sustainable label “For Life”. "I imagined an androgynous orange blossom that you want to smell again and again... Facetted with fusing spices and a bewitching heart of jasmine and neroli, its powerful trail melts into a hypnotic woody base of sandalwood and vetiver." - Anne Flipo, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: VELVET IRIS Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Ode to the velvety petals of the flower, Dominique Ropion delivers a woody, carnal interpretation of the iris. It all begins with a breath of spicy freshness, rising like the majestic stem of the iris: pink pepper and turmeric leaf electrify buchu leaf with aromatic and herbaceous accents. Balanced by the crisp greenness of galbanum and lentisque, the precious iris concrete gradually warms on the skin, revealing more carnal inflections, both creamy and powdery. Sensuality blooms ever so softly, brought to life by the drydown of Velvet Iris: a woven from the milky notes of sandalwood, the warmth of labdanum and the contemporary vibrations of Saffiano™, an exclusive IFF molecule that combines the power of leather with the softness of suede. A truly languorous experience, Velvet Iris reveals its powerful yet caressingly soft signature when worn. A hypnotic trail, elegant and infinitely carnal. "I imagined a woody iris as an ode to the flower’s velvety petals. Pulsing with the suave radiance of pink pepper and buchu, it unfolds its green facets, infused with galbanum. Ambered and creamy woods embrace it in an infinitely carnal skin-to-skin caress." - Dominique Ropion, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: ATHÉNAÏS Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: A Floral Ambery fragrance opening with vibrant and sparkling notes of neroli and yuzu bringing an immediate sense of uplifting dynamism. The heart unfolds with the elegance and generosity of orange flower and jasmine. Followed by a base that deepens with a modern duo of tonka beans and vanilla bringing a powdery and addicting facet to the fragrance and further balanced with the comforting note of amber - adding warmth and depth. Top notes: Neroli, Bergamot, YuzuHeart notes: Orange Blossom, JasmineBase notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Ambrox

listings.rawTitle: Gris Charnel Shower Gel 300 ml
listings.description: Born from David Benedek’s vision of bringing emotions to life through scent, the new “Le Soin Parfumé” collection—comprising shower gel and body lotion—extends the olfactory signature of the fragrances and enhances the ritual. listings.rawTitle: COLOGNE 01 Eau de Cologne Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Cologne One captures the freshness of a gin and tonic in a single, sparkling gesture: effervescent, bright, unmistakably clean. The fragrance lives in its top notes: juniper for the gin, lime and citrus for lift, a touch of bergamot and mandarin, a whisper of ginger for a delicate spiciness, and a hint of cucumber’s neutrality to enhance the crispness without becoming literal. It is freshness concentrated, transparent, and immediate. The heart remains understated: iris, rose, and hadione offer just enough structure to support the top note, allowing the bright citrus and juniper to linger. The dry down is linear, calm, and unobtrusive: Ambroxan, Iso E Super, and a trace of musk. Nothing competes, nothing distracts. “We have a very different approach to fragrance, so our first cologne captures the very unique and wonderful freshness of a gin and tonic. I think it's quite new with that sort of freshness. It's the idea of the sparkling, effervescent gin and tonic first scent, this sort of your nose in the drink.” – Geza Schoen, perfumer. listings.rawTitle: Tonka Kumaru Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: A gourmand, sensual creation that reveals the tonka bean in all its depth. Its almond nuances unfold first, enhanced by hints of vanilla, woods, and musk, creating an addictive and deeply enveloping fragrance. "I wanted to reveal the raw beauty of the tonka bean, highlighting its almond notes, gourmand and comforting, which instantly bring me back to the Cléopâtre glue of childhood, that iconic little pot known to generations of French schoolchildren, and its mischievous temptation to taste it. A true olfactory madeleine, reimagined as a contemporary object of desire." – Véronique Le Bihan, Founder Top notes: Bergamot Essence, Bitter Almond Extract, Cardamom EssenceHeart notes: Roasted Barley Extract, Hay Absolute, Cedar LeafBase notes: Roasted Tonka Bean Extract, Vanilla Resinoid, Amber, Musks

listings.rawTitle: Vanille Carbone Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: With Vanille Carbone, perfumer Natalie Gracia-Cetto explores the depth of a black vanilla pod, blending three exceptional qualities of Madagascar Vanilla. The fragrance unfolds with the vibrant spice of pink peppercorn and black pepper. At its heart, the smoky elegance of incense meets the luminous allure of a patent leather accord. In the base, vanilla unveils its warm, sensual, and delectable facets, leaving an irresistible trail. A monochrome canvas of contrasting textures, between matt and shine, shadow and light, revealing the full intensity of black vanilla. “In Vanille Carbone, I wanted to showcase the rich, leathery, and spicy nuances of Madagascar Vanilla, offering a contemporary twist on a classic ingredient. I sought to move away from the familiar sweet, gourmand notes and instead invite a new way of experiencing vanilla, one that is bold and unexpected. In this creation, vanilla unveils its deep black hue and contrasting facets. A monochrome canvas of contrasting textures between matte and shine, shadow and light, revealing the full intensity of black vanilla.” – Véronique Le Bihan, Founder. Top notes: Madagascan Pepper, Pink PepperHeart notes: Leather, Somali IncenseBase notes: Bourbon Vanilla Absolute (incl. CO₂ extract)

listings.rawTitle: Cèdre Figalia Eau de Parfum Unisex 10ml
listings.description: In CÈDRE FIGALIA, perfumer Céline Perdriel selects three varieties of cedar, each bringing nuance and character to the fragrance. Cedar Virginia, with its subtle and elegant notes, Cedar Alaska, for its invigorating freshness, and Cedar Atlas, for its warm and enveloping aura. Masterpiece of balance and elegance, the combination of those three varieties blends harmoniously with the fig, meticulously crafted here in its entirety to capture the refreshing essence of its foliage as well as the delightful milky sweetness of its fruit. The fragrance opens with uplifting notes of bergamot and basil, sparked by the spicy and woody facets of Jamaica pepper. In the middle, the vegetal notes of spinach and maté blend perfectly with the crisp and milky accords of the fig. All majestically carried by a sturdy, yet delicate base of cedar essence, bringing earthy depth and woody warmth to that sparkling vegetal blend. “A fragrance that evokes vegetal life in all its forms: wood, sap, leaf and fruit. A tribute to nature, highlighting the contrast between all raw materials.” – Véronique Le Bihan, Founder. Top notes: Bergamot, Basil, Jamaican PepperHeart notes: Spinach, Maté, Fig LeafBase notes: Cedarwood, Milky Fig Notes, Dry Wood

listings.rawTitle: Rose Ardoise Eau de Parfum Unisex 10ml
listings.description: The perfumer Céline Perdriel highlights two exceptional varieties of rose: the Damascena rose from Turkey, with its floral, fruity and spicy notes, and the Centifolia rose from Grasse, with its round, warm and honeyed facets. In ROSE ARDOISE, the perfumer plays on ambiguities, combining femininity and masculinity, transparency and texture, minerality and sensuality. The fragrance opens with fresh, spicy notes of schinus molle and nutmeg that reflect the clear, crystalline vibration of sage. Then, the rose expresses itself entirely before progressively melting into an overdose of ambroxan. „An interpretation of an urban and contemporary rose blooming from a concrete ground. A fragrance that blurs the lines between feminine and masculine.“ – Véronique Le Bihan, Founder. Top notes: Nutmeg, Schinus Molle (Pink Pepper)Heart notes: Rose, SageBase notes: Vetiver, Leather, Ambroxan

listings.rawTitle: Narcisse Taiji Eau de Parfum Unisex 10ml
listings.description: The perfumer Marie Hugentobler selects the exceptional narcissus growing in the French Aubrac mountains. Almost 1,600 kilograms of these wild flowers, picked by local growers, are needed to produce a kilogram of narcissus absolute, with its powerful and delicate floral facets. In NARCISSE TAIJI, the perfumer highlights the opposite forces in this precious and multifaceted flower. To the luminous and vegetal side of the freshly picked flower, the perfumer opposes the dark and animal side of the narcissus, enhanced by leather and patchouli accents. A perfect balance, surprising and sensual. „The olfactory interpretation of Yin and Yang, where the Narcissus flower is worked in chiaroscuro. A contrast between light and shadow, strength and delicacy.“ – Véronique Le Bihan, Founder Top notes: Pear, Ginger, TuberoseHeart notes: Narcissus, Absolute of Hay and BranBase notes: Leather, Patchouli, Musk

listings.rawTitle: Cacao Porcelana Eau de Parfum Unisex 10ml
listings.description: A rare variety, this white cocoa grows in the heart of the oldest plantations, in Piura, north-west Peru. Extracted by hand from the pods, the beans are fermented before being sun-dried and roasted. In order to capture the most beautiful facets of this white cocoa, the perfumer collaborated with a French Maître Chocolatier to obtain the perfect roasting, thus revealing sensual nutty and milky notes, with Tonka bean undertone. After a sweet rum opening, the perfumer Marie Hugentobler unveils the addictive bitterness of the cocoa, comforted by powdery and woody notes. A dry down of light tobacco, patchouli and sandalwood follows, giving CACAO PORCELANA its sensual and unique signature. „Cacao Porcelana is inspired by childhood memories with my grandparents. The smell of chocolate blends with the scent of tobacco and Patchouli perfume. A true Proustian madeleine.“ – Véronique Le Bihan, Founder Top notes: White Cocoa, Rum, PeriwinkleHeart notes: Indian Jasmine, Light Tobacco, DavanaBase notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean

listings.rawTitle: Santal Blond Eau de Parfum Unisex 10ml
listings.description: Sacred tree, sandalwood is a peculiar exotic wood. Once distilled, powerful velvety, creamy notes with smoky undertones are unleashed. After a fresh and spicy opening carried by the cardamom, the perfumer pairs the sandalwood with rich floral jasmine notes and warm Tonka bean accents. „A delicate and luminous interpretation of Sandalwood where the wood’s reassuring character is softly and elegantly revealed. A bewitching caress on the skin.“ – Véronique Le Bihan, Founder Top notes: Bergamot, CardamomHeart notes: Jasmine, SandalwoodBase notes: Hinoki Bourbon, Tonka Bean

It is fresh, green, pungent, and evocative of the grass, the expanse of fields, the sweeping sea. It is an everyday scent, light enough to meld with skin and project its presence with a subtle aura. listings.rawTitle: Andy Warhol. Polaroids 1958-1987 Coffee Table Books 1 piece
listings.description: Andy Warhol was a relentless chronicler of life and its encounters. Carrying a Polaroid camera from the late 1950s until his death in 1987, he amassed a huge collection of instant pictures of friends, lovers, patrons, the famous, the obscure, the scenic, the fashionable, and himself. Created in collaboration with the Andy Warhol Foundation, this book features hundreds of these instant photos. Portraits of celebrities such as Mick Jagger, Alfred Hitchcock, Jack Nicholson, Yves Saint Laurent, Pelé, Debbie Harry are included alongside images of Warhol’s entourage and high life, landscapes, and still lifes from Cabbage Patch dolls to the iconic soup cans. Often raw and impromptu, the Polaroids document Warhol’s era like Instagram captures our own, offering a unique record of the life, world, and vision behind the Pop Art maestro and modernist giant. © The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts, Inc.

listings.rawTitle: Decorative Art 60s Coffee Table Books 1 piece
listings.description: Published annually from 1906 until 1980, Decorative Art, The Studio Yearbook was dedicated to the latest currents in architecture, interiors, furniture, lighting, glassware, textiles, metalware, and ceramics. Since the publications went out of print, the now hard-to-find yearbooks have become highly prized by collectors and dealers. Decorative Art 1960s looks at the birth of pop in a decade of unprecedented social, sexual, and political change. All the restless energies bubbling throughout the world during the 1960s made their way into the design style of the decade. Liberation was in the air, men were rushing to the moon, and the sky was the limit as far as visual creativity was concerned. The concept of lifestyle really came into its own, and although the early years of the decade still saw a rivalry between the well-crafted object and the industrially manufactured, by its end both ethnic and pop iconography had gained equal foothold in the aesthetic. Light was also predominant in shaping interiors. Freedom of choice and personal expression were the buzzwords for the young consumer, and so the likes of Panton, Sottsass, Paolozzi, Parisi, Sarpaneva, and Lomazzi did what they could to oblige.

listings.description: Last Resort opens in a radiant burst of shimmering aldehydes - an airy, luminous accord that feels both clean and crisp, yet soft against the skin. As the fragrance unfolds, creamy sandalwood, cashmere wood, and cedarwood melt together, wrapping the senses in an intimate, sensual cocoon. Soft milky and musky tones weave through the composition, creating a smooth, second-skin warmth. Elegant, comforting, quietly addictive. A molecular fragrance that evolves with the wearer, revealing a woody amber, creamy, sensual trail that feels uniquely yours. Notes: Aldehyde, Pink Pepper, Sandalwood, Cedarwood, White Musk, Amber, Cashmere.

listings.rawTitle: Orphéon EDT Eau de Toilette Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: In 1960s Saint-Germain, the three founders of Diptyque would meet at the Orphéon jazz club to dance, laugh, and discuss the state of the world in an atmosphere as vibrant as it is elegant. A beloved bar brimming with the effervescence of artistic possibility in a Parisian quarter that has always been cosmopolitan, spontaneous, and festive. Orphéon Eau de Toilette is a tribute to the opening moments of an evening out at this legendary venue. The stunning composition, with its citrus fruit, spicy notes and vibrant woodiness, is an immersion into the special feeling of excitement that arises while the night is still young. A fleeting meet-up that leads to encounters yet unknown. A tribute to creative friendships and a radiant interpretation of an olfactory time capsule, Orphéon Eau de Toilette immortalises an ephemeral facet of a bygone era. Notes: Green mandarin, juniper berries, cedar

Creamy tonka bean swirls into the heart, its almond-like richness infused with a hint of saffron spice, adding a touch of warmth. The base is where things get truly interesting: orcanox, vanilla, and white musks create a cloud of sensual warmth, while grey amber and modern woods ground the sweetness with a subtle, animalic edge – it's unexpected, but oh-so-addictive, and a creamy, milky, powdery-floral companion for all occasions. For whom? Dirty Heaven is for those who seek beauty laced with a touch of intrigue. Those who find the most captivating scents exist just on the edge of familiar, where the sweet and the subtly sinful intertwine. Powered by the most potent dose of patented Healing Concentrate™ yet, this advanced formula works to reduce fine lines and wrinkles, firm skin and provide deep hydration. Clinically proven to boost radiance and improve skin texture, it also corrects hyperpigmentation and strengthens the skin barrier. Infused with Sage and Pumpkin Seed Extracts, Elixir soothes and reduces redness, minimises blemishes and imperfections, and helps to calm and balance skin. Skin appears instantly revitalised, with visible improvements in tone, texture and resilience over time.

listings.rawTitle: Cooling Hydrogel Under Eye Patches Eyepads & Masks 30 piece
listings.description: These cooling patches are designed to soothe and rejuvenate the delicate skin around your eyes. Helping to diminish the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles while reducing puffiness. A blend of Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, Caffeine, Tiger Grass and Red Algae work to nourish and replenish, leaving your eyes feeling calm and revitalized. Lightweight and easy to apply, these under-eye patches stay in place, making them perfect for a quick pick-me-up or a relaxing self-care moment.

listings.rawTitle: Peach Skin Body Mist Fragrance Bodyspray 236 ml
listings.description: Beneath a peach's velvety, soft skin, a juicy, succulent bite beckons. Peach Skin's immediate burst of fresh fruit flirts with the brightness of bergamot and the crispness of a bellini. A haze of sheer amber surrounds milky sandalwood and coconut caramel to enrich the tactile sweetness with a faint yet sumptuous warmth. "I wanted to capture the feeling of biting into a perfectly ripe peach as the soft velvety skin gives way to the sweet juice. The fruity sensation of that first bite is elevated with sparkling bellini for radiance and earthy sandalwood for creaminess. Altogether, the aroma channels the quintessential experience of peak-season fruit." – Clement Gavarry, Peach Skin Perfumer Top notes: Peach Bellini, Plum, Peach Skin, Bergamot Heart notes: White Freesia, Vanilla Orchid, Jasmine Nectar Base notes: Milky Sandalwood, Sheer Amber, Coconut Caramel

listings.rawTitle: Beach Skin Body Mist Fragrance Bodyspray 236 ml
listings.description: Taste the gauzy ocean mist, feel the heat of sand, and watch the dappled light dance across the waves. Beach Skin bottles the kiss of sun and skin as soft tiare blossoms wash over traces of salty air accented by the citrusy spark of bergamot. A transparent veil of coconut milk and sandalwood linger on skin leaving remnants of creamy warmth that’s both airy and sensual. "I wanted to capture the feeling of stepping off the beach at golden hour, when your skin is still warmed by the sun after a long summer day. It's that blend of salty air, sun-kissed skin, and traces of sunscreen, with the sensation of sand still clinging to your skin. Light, fresh bergamot, the softness of coconut and a hint of fresh melon, wrapped up in the comfort of sandalwood, vanilla and musk — make the ultimate scent for a summer day." – Arielle Le Beau, Beach Skin Perfumer Top notes: Bergamot, Salted Tiare Flower, Pink Pepper Heart notes: Coconut Milk, Lily of the Valley Base notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla, Musk

listings.rawTitle: Existence Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: An expression of the serenity of endlessness, Existence is based around a heart-breaking note of Lily of the Valley. Delicate and fragile, it is also possessed of a remarkable expansiveness, thanks to the addition of Frankincense. As the scent develops, an Aldehyde facet enhances the impression of pristine whiteness, while Rose adds living, breathing physicality. In the base, Benzoin connects the landscape to the complex reality of the earth. Bright, sincere and emotive, Existence conveys the incomprehensible vastness of the infinite, with all of its life-affirming optimism. Top Notes: Lily of the Valley, RoseHeart Notes: Frankincense, Mystikal, LabdanumBase Notes: Ambergris, White Musk, Benzoin

listings.rawTitle: Decision Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Starting with an olfactory bolt of lightning, Decision banishes the darkness of uncertainty – an effect achieved through a combination of the cool woodiness and citrus-mineralic sparkle of Frankincense, Bergamot, Myrrh and Juniper Berries. After this striking opening, the light spreads further, aided by the gleaming sheen of Atlas Cedarwood. Finally, a warm Vanilla in the base conveys the profoundly liberating effect of acceptance. Uncompromising, distinctive and incandescent, Decision captures the paradox that lies at the core of all of life’s most powerful decisions: it is focused on its goal while remaining open to countless possibilities. Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Bergamot, CardamomHeart Notes: Frankincense, Juniper, MyrrhBase Notes: Patchouli, Cedarwood, Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: M+ PATCHOULI Atomizer Refill Eau de Toilette Unisex 3 x 8,5ml Refill
listings.description: An ultimate artcessory, the ATOM.iser. is a luxurious, travel-sized fragrance case crafted for durability and designed to elevate your on-the-go lifestyle. Its twist-and-spray mechanism ensures your favourite EM scent is always at hand. The sleek metal is meticulously blasted with stainless steel 'sand' to burnish the surface to a soft lustre and is then anodised for lasting resilience. Molecule 01 + Patchouli consists of Iso E Super + Patchouli. "Patchouli is a unique natural. Unlike 99% of perfume ingredients, we associate it with a particular period, the sixties and seventies and that bohemian spirit. It has a cool, rather aloof woodiness to it, and I love it for its moody beauty. I've used two qualities of patchouli here. The biggest chunk is Patchouli Coeur, a very clean, soft patchouli oil fraction with the camphor-like topnote removed. I have also included a patchouli oil from Indonesia to round it out with a little bit of a topnote. The result is a sophisticated, clean patchouli that pairs fantastically well with Molecule 01." – Geza Schoen, perfumer & founder. The Refill Set offers three 8.5ml refills that slot effortlessly into your ATOM.iser.

listings.rawTitle: Pacific Rock Flower Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Fresh and captivating, Pacific Rock Flower conjures the beauty of Australia’s sunlit coastline. A sparkling aquatic perfume where native white florals meet the salty breeze, softened by creamy woods and the warmth of golden sand. An uplifting scent that evokes barefoot walks on coastal headlands, with waves crashing below and wildflowers swaying above. An olfactory interpretation of the white coastal tea tree flower, Pacific Rock Flower blends sea air and florals in a bright, free-spirited composition. This native flower thrives along Australia’s eastern shores, flourishing in the salt spray and sunshine. Its essential oil, drawn from wild tea tree, adds clarity and freshness, layered with luminous notes of tuberose, coral flower, and creamy cocowax. A base of patchouli and Australian sandalwood adds warmth and depth.

listings.rawTitle: Solid Perfume rechargable Do Son Perfume unisex 3g

listings.rawTitle: Solid Perfume rechargeable Rose Perfume unisex 3g
listings.description: Placing the rose centre stage, this scented wax, to be applied to the skin with the fingertips, brings out the full delicacy and floral intensity of Eau Rose.A fragrance gesture, a tribute to a flower iconic among perfumers, in a box with a colour illustration.Notes: Damasena rose, Centifolia rose, Litchi accord

listings.rawTitle: Refill x2 Solid Perfume Do Son Perfume unisex 2x3g Refill
listings.description: Prolong the journey. This solid perfume refill extends the sillage of Do Son. listings.rawTitle: Tobacco Absolute Eau de Parfum Eau de Parfum Men 100ml
listings.description: Warm depth, spicy intensity, and woody elegance combine to create a fragrance that exudes character and sensuality. Tobacco Absolute opens with the intense, slightly smoky note of tobacco, balanced by the dry clarity of cedarwood. As the fragrance unfolds, the lively spice of ginger emerges, lending the composition a subtle freshness and dynamism. The individual facets blend into a harmonious, multi-layered fragrance structure that is both powerful and elegant. A composition that combines warmth and expression, depth and modern clarity. Top notes: Spicy gingerHeart notes: Aromatic tobaccoBase notes: Dry cedarwood

listings.rawTitle: Dark Leather Eau de Parfum Eau de Parfum Men 100ml
listings.description: Smoky depth, aromatic freshness, and leathery intensity combine to create a fragrance that exudes a mysterious, powerful aura. Dark Leather opens with the warm, resinous note of elemi, which immediately imparts a spicy, slightly balsamic warmth. At the heart, the green, slightly floral freshness of geranium unfolds, giving the composition structure and clarity. The base is characterized by smoky leather, which lends the fragrance its distinctive, intense signature. An unexpected nuance of crisp lavender runs through the composition, bringing a subtle freshness that elegantly balances the dark depth. A composition that unites smoke and freshness, strength and elegance. Top notes: Resinous elemiHeart notes: Aromatic geranium, lavenderBase notes: Smoky leather

listings.rawTitle: Heavenly Gingerlily Eau de Parfum Eau de Parfum Women 100 ml
listings.description: This floral composition combines spicy freshness with sensual floral richness, transporting you to an elegant, exotic world of scent. The opening is marked by invigorating ginger and aromatic cardamom, which lend the fragrance a lively, slightly spicy freshness. At the heart, opulent white flowers unfold: tuberose and lily blend into a soft, feminine bouquet with creamy depth. The hyacinth lends the fragrance a green, slightly powdery nuance and creates a refined, modern signature. The interplay of fresh, spicy, and floral notes results in a balanced, sensual composition that develops elegantly on the skin and lingers for a long time. Top notes: Ginger, cardamom.Heart notes: Tuberose, lily, hyacinth.Base notes: Floral accords, green notes.

listings.rawTitle: Orange & Bergamot Eau de Parfum Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: This lively, fresh fragrance composition combines citrus notes with a natural, green depth. The opening is defined by zesty orange and bergamot, which lend the fragrance a clear, energetic freshness. As the scent unfolds, petitgrain reveals its characteristic signature, bringing an elegant, slightly tart, and green nuance to the composition. The balance of fruity freshness and subtle bitterness gives the fragrance its timeless sophistication. The interplay is invigorating, modern, and yet classic—an iconic fragrance that unfolds on the skin with clarity, lightness, and character. Top notes: Orange, bergamot.Heart notes: Petitgrain.Base notes: Citrus and green accords.

listings.rawTitle: Tea Ceremony Eau de Parfum Eau de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: Hit pause on the chaos of life and savour your own private tea ceremony – however you like it served. This unisex perfume is a contemporary blend of dewy nashi pear, earthy matcha accord and a signature note of herbaceous green tea, grounding you with the rich, woody hush of hinoki wood for a calm that lingers. Top notes: Nashi pearHeart notes: Green teaBase notes: Hinoki wood

listings.rawTitle: BOIS IMPERIAL Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Freshly crushed and spicy Thai Basil leaves meet the sparkling peppery and grapefruit facets of Nepalese Timut Pepper absolute. A brilliant combination that contrasts perfectly with the bold woody signature of the fragrance. A green, rich and earthy Haitian Vetiver oil echoes with Georgywood – an exclusive molecule with powerful cedarwood tones. This vibrating woody association is illuminated by the sophisticated floralcy of Petalia. Majestic Akigalawood truly signs the fragrance. This exclusive natural ingredient is upcycled from Patchouli through a biotechnology process. Its unique spicy-woody character is enhanced by a rich Indonesian Patchouli oil and a powerful, sustainable note of Ambrofix. "I created this fragrance around a precious and extraordinary wood: Akigalawood. Adorned with fresh spices, it is a great woody note made of contrasts, between patchouli and Thai Basil." – Quentin Bisch, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: NICE BERGAMOTE Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Nice Bergamote is a vibrant tribute to the aristocratic beauty of a Natural Calabrian bergamot. It is really the queen of this perfume. She is wrapped in a floral accord in which one finds natural rose and jasmin petals and most of all a sustainable natural Ylang Ylang from Comoros Archipelago with a support locally for education and school supplies extracted by lowering the impact on the local ecosystem and by implementing a replanting program of trees. Its trail sillage wraps up on a precious natural cedarwood wooden accord, softened by a sustainable natural Tonka beans from Venezuela, in the region of Caura River, Venezuela. Its sustainable sourcing program allows to preserve local fauna and communities from Amazonia. supporting local communities with agreement to protect the local fauna. “I imagined this fragrance as a vibrant tribute to the aristocratic beauty of Calabrian bergamot, sublimating it with a few rose and jasmine petals and precious woods softened by tonka bean.” – Antoine Maisondieu, Perfumer

listings.rawTitle: NICE BERGAMOTE Extrait de Parfum Unisex 30 ml

More gourmand, more narcotic, more intoxicating, the scent reveals itself under a shadowed facet, unveiling a rare intensity thanks to a concentration twice that of the Eau de Parfum.​ The full intensity of a mediterranean summer night.

listings.rawTitle: ORANGE X SANTAL Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Radiant and joyful, natural bitter orange and natural sandalwood transport you to the Italian coast. The bright juice of the orange is offset by the aromatic bitterness from its peel, rounded out with basil essential oil from Egypt. French oak moss provides a chypre accord, while natural French cypress wood essential oil and Australian sandalwood anchor the luminous top notes. The natural sandalwood oil was harvested by Aboriginal communities in Western Australia, promoting a sustainable supply of the precious ingredient. “I imagined a fresh and sensual fragrance where the sparkling and luscious facets of bitter orange from Italy play with a magnificent, soft and creamy Australian sandalwood album.” – Natalie Gracia Cetto, perfumer.

listings.rawTitle: ROSE MAGNETIC Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: The most sensual of all flowers displays all its facets in this creation — playful, addictive, and modern in turn. A hint of bitter grapefruit and fresh peppermint contrast against the lush femininity of the rose. Layers of lychee, natural cedarwood, musks, and natural vanilla bean add to its intoxicating appeal. At the core of Rose Magnetic is a combination of natural Rose Essential™ LMR and natural Turkish Rose Absolute LMR, both certified “For Life.” Each is sustainably produced, with the goal of providing more stable wages to local communities. "I imagined a duet of roses (Rose Essential and Rose Absolute from Turkey) expressing the multiplicity and sensuality of this flower on a vibrant and captivating musk base note." - Sophie Labbé, Perfumer

listings.rawTitle: TLY5755 Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: A calm, elegant fragrance that captures the essence of Australian landscapes. Spicy and woody notes blend with aromatic nuances to create a modern, minimalist composition. The molecule Iso E Super lends the fragrance an almost skin-close, intimate presence and underscores its personal character. The fragrance is understated yet full of character and unfolds uniquely on the skin. listings.description: Pore refinement, powered by science. listings.description: This innovative fascia brush was developed to intensively stimulate the skin, fascia, and deeper tissues. The intense massage has an invigorating, smoothing, and gently exfoliating effect and can visibly refine the skin’s texture.

listings.description: The Light Frequency Gua Sha combines classic Gua Sha techniques with modern EMS, vibration, and LED technology. What makes Reflection 45 Man an Exceptional Extrait? A fragrance is usually a mix of a concentrate (containing fragrant oils) and an alcoholic base. listings.rawTitle: TOOTHPASTE BIOTIC Tooth Paste 85 ml
listings.description: The first probiotic toothpaste designed to support the oral microbiome! The fluoride- and titanium dioxide-free MINT Biotic Toothpaste combines powerful cleaning performance with targeted care, helping regulate the microbial balance in your mouth. The oral microbiome is home to the second-largest and most diverse community of microorganisms in the human body. Within the oral cavity, beneficial and harmful bacteria, viruses, fungi, and other microbes coexist in a delicate balance.When this balance is disrupted, harmful bacteria can multiply—leading to conditions like cavities, periodontitis, fungal infections, mouth ulcers (aphthae), and bad breath. As we age, the oral microbiome becomes more vulnerable to imbalances and therefore requires more support and protection. That’s why the MINT Biotic line by Dr. Mintcheva was developed—the first probiotic toothpaste featuring the innovative active ingredient SymReboot, designed to help you maintain a healthy, balanced oral environment. It gently eliminates harmful bacteria while supporting the growth of beneficial ones. This significantly reduces the risk of fungal infections, aphthae, cavities, and other conditions affecting the oral mucosa. Hydroxyapatite, a natural component of teeth also known as “artificial enamel,” strengthens enamel and makes teeth more resistant to cavities. It also helps protect exposed tooth necks from sensitivity. Thanks to MPT1 Ultra Polish Technology© with perlite as a polishing agent, MINT Biotic Toothpaste offers a high level of cleaning power with low abrasion. It gently and effectively removes deep-set stains, restores your natural whiteness with regular use, and helps prevent new discoloration. It even helps reduce tartar buildup. The formula is vegan and free from harmful ingredients such as microplastics, abrasives, PEGs, and parabens.

listings.rawTitle: GUM CARE BIOTIC Oral Care 75 ml
listings.description: We care for our skin – the body’s largest organ – with creams and specialized products. But what about our oral mucosa? Every day, we expose our sensitive gums and palate to stress through food, drinks, and lifestyle habits. And because oral mucosa differs significantly from tooth structure, it requires dedicated care. MINT Biotic Gum Gel is the first probiotic oral care gel with the hero ingredient SymReboot, clinically proven to strengthen and nourish the gums. It promotes a balanced and healthy oral microbiome, provides lasting moisture, and helps prevent and reduce bad breath. Additionally, it supplies the delicate oral tissues with essential nutrients like Vitamin E and B12. Vitamin E has anti-inflammatory properties and supports cell regeneration. Vitamin B12 contributes to the normal function of the immune and nervous systems. Natural cucumber extract adds antibacterial benefits. The Biotic Gel is especially recommended after dental treatments or oral surgery. It can be applied locally to problem areas such as canker sores or periodontal pockets, or spread generously across the tongue. For best results, Dr. Mintcheva recommends applying MINT Biotic Gum Gel to the gums and tongue after brushing – and not rinsing afterwards. The formula is free from microplastics and 100% vegan.

listings.rawTitle: MOUTHWASH BIOTIC Oral Care 200 ml
listings.description: Did you know that our oral microbiome is the second largest and most diverse microbial community in the body? Our oral microbiota is an extremely complex ecosystem – home to over 700 different bacterial species that colonize the teeth, gums, oral mucosa, and throat. Both beneficial and harmful bacteria, viruses, fungi, and other microorganisms coexist in the mouth – living in a coordinated community. However, when this balance is disrupted, harmful bacteria can multiply. This, in turn, can lead to conditions such as cavities, periodontitis, fungal infections, canker sores, and bad breath. That’s why it is so important to understand the interactions between the various microorganisms in our oral microbiome and, above all, to support and stabilize this balance. Especially as we age, our oral flora becomes more susceptible to disease and therefore requires increased care and protection. For this reason, the MINT Biotic line by Dr. Mintcheva was developed. It is the first probiotic mouthwash designed to support you on your journey to a completely healthy and balanced oral microbiome. It promotes the habitat of beneficial bacteria, preventing harmful ones from spreading. Thanks to the probiotic hero ingredient SymReboot, the immune defenses of the oral mucosa are strengthened, allowing good microorganisms to thrive while more effectively combating harmful bacteria responsible for bad breath, fungal infections, canker sores, and cavities. Vitamins E and B12 help care for and protect the gums and oral mucosa. The included skin vitamin E protects sensitive tissues from damage with its antioxidant properties and supports the regeneration of skin cells. Vitamin B12 helps prevent dryness and inflammation in the mouth. The alcohol-free formula naturally possesses antibacterial properties thanks to peppermint oil and cucumber extract. This helps to reduce the acidity in the mouth – a common cause of cavities. The formula is also 100% vegan and free from microplastics.

Top notes: Jasmine and SaffronHeart notes: Mossy woody accordBase notes: Ethyl-maltol, Ambroxan™

listings.rawTitle: Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum Unisex 200 ml
listings.description: Baccarat Rouge 540 is a universal, luminous and intense fragrance with woody ambery floral notes, a truly graphic olfactory signature condensed to the extreme. A one-of-a-kind graphic and extremely condensed olfactory signature, with a long-lasting sillage. It was born from the encounter between Maison Francis Kurkdjian and Baccarat, whose 250th anniversary was celebrated with this eau de parfum that evokes the transparency and density of crystal. Francis Kurkdjian wanted to convey the poetic alchemy of crystal-making in this woody ambery floral fragrance, by imagining a unique creation based on 3 auras. In the top notes, the breezy facets of jasmine flowers and the radiance of saffron evoke the aura of air. They are highlighted by an accord evoking ambergris and dry woody tones, embodying the mineral aura.Lastly, the aura of fire is suggested by the addictive sensuality of ethyl maltol, a note with gourmand facets. Luminous and refined, Baccarat Rouge 540 eau de parfum caresses the skin with an enveloping woody, ambery, floral whisper. ‘This singular sillage gives a mysterious facet to this fragrance. Baccarat Rouge 540 symbolizes the alchemy of senses.’ Francis Kurkdjian Top notes: Jasmine and SaffronHeart notes: Mossy woody accordBase notes: Ethyl-maltol, Ambroxan™ (amber, dry woody and mineral note).

listings.rawTitle: Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum Unisex 200 ml
listings.description: Baccarat Rouge 540 is a universal, luminous and intense fragrance with woody ambery floral notes, a truly graphic olfactory signature condensed to extreme. The extrait de parfum intensifies the power and radiance of the eau de parfum’s three ‘auras’, without betraying the original poetic alchemy inspired by the crystal manufacture. The top notes of Grandiflorum jasmine flowers delicately underscore the aura of air. The sensual fire aura conveyed by ethyl maltol, a note with gourmand facets, is enhanced by the subtle notes of bitter almond. Lastly, the mineral aura built around an ambergris accord softens with a woody ambery musky accord. Adding to the intensity of the extrait, the perfume bottle also plays with light. Its aesthetic dons a brilliant red robe reminiscent of Baccarat red. Baccarat Rouge 540 Maison Francis Kurkdjian extrait de parfum embodies the profusion and fusion of elements that can only be tamed by the art of the perfumer and the wisdom gained with time. ‘This singular sillage gives a mysterious facet to this fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Rain Wood Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Smoke Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Fig Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Salt Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Saddle Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Steam Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml

Notes: Mandarin (Italy), Plum, Green Tea, Coriander, Black Pepper, Birch Tar, Cedar Wood Virginia, Juniper Wood France, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Incense Incense sticks 30 piece

listings.rawTitle: Oud Maracuja Extrait Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: Oud Maracujá takes you to the heart of an oud wood forest and presents you with an exotic contrast between the thirst-quenching freshness of passion fruit and the tropical heat of oud wood. This unique accord is enhanced by the lushness of saffron, Indonesian patchouli and leather, then softened by benzoin from Laos and a duo of Turkish rose and vanilla absolutes. Relish in the unexpected with this fruity, woody extrait de parfum, which offers intense staying power and a long-lasting sillage!

listings.rawTitle: CASTLEY Eau de Parfum Unisex 125 ml
listings.description: Castley is inspired by the audacity and vision of 18th-century French explorers, who ventured into the unknown to discover new horizons. This fragrance embodies the same spirit of adventure and the modern man's thirst for exploration. With a transparent smoked bottle that symbolizes both urban sophistication and passion, Castley represents the bold, adventurous man ready to break boundaries and achieve new goals. Thanks to meticulously selected high-end ingredients, this Eau de Parfum expresses the perfect balance between luminous freshness and spicy energy, reflecting a vigorous man always on the move. Breezy citrus and mineral notes contrast with spicy Timut pepper, amber Labdanum, and noble Akigalawood, unveiling an intense side. A vibrant fragrance, embodying intrepidity and confidence with a unique history, shaping the trail of a bold ascent. “Thanks to bright citrus notes contrasted by the richness of spices and the nobility of woody-amber accords, this new composition offers a surprising impression of movement as well as balance.” – Julien Sprecher, Founder and Artistic Director of Parfums de Marly. Top notes: Bergamot, Fresh Ginger, Black PepperHeart notes: Petitgrain Citronnier, Timut Pepper, Neroli AccordBase notes: Akigalawood, Labdanum, Benzoin Accord

listings.rawTitle: Perfume Oil Painted Desert Perfume Oil & Rollerballs Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Painted Desert is a fragrance born from a natural landscape that awes the senses in its scale and color. Notes of sage, frankincense, cedar, and sandalwood form an elemental base, layered with dewy brightness where the sun’s heat meets the cool ground’s breath. Desert heat and ancient stone. Earth and air in suspended dialogue. Softer to the skin than alcohol-based fragrances, Painted Desert perfume oil is packaged in a travel-friendly roll-on bottle that contains a highly concentrated form of the scent. The perfume is carried by an oil blend based on jojoba oil extract appropriate to pleasantly anoint the skin with. Encounter new facets of the fragrance revealed by the oil in touch with skin.

listings.rawTitle: Tales of Amber Parfum Perfume unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Tales of Amber draws on the mysterious allure of ambergris—one of perfumery's rarest treasures—and reinterprets it through a distinctly Australian perspective. This new extrait de parfum explores the interplay of time, landscape, and transformation, opening a bold new chapter in the brand's Botanical Series. Tales of Amber opens with the mineral freshness of moss and the floral clarity of orange blossom. The heart reveals powdery iris and sun-warmed cinnamon, gently enveloped in a veil of musk and resinous rockrose. The true depth of the fragrance unfolds in the drydown: an opulent blend of ambergris, Australian agarwood, and smoked vanilla, carried by a warm, leathery trail that lingers on the skin like sunlight on stone. Notes: New Zealand Ambergris, De Laire Amber 83 (Labdanum & Vanillin), Australian Agarwood, Orange Blossom, Iris, Cinnamon, Oud

listings.rawTitle: Petit Sauvage Perfume Oil Perfume Oil & Rollerballs Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: A fragrance shaped by raw landscapes and ­crafted from untamed ­elements and wild ­botanicals. It opens with a sting—handpicked pink ­pepper, wild juniper from high-­altitude forests, wild lime, and warm saffron, dry as desert air. At its ­heart, a surprise: Golden pineapple ripened under open skies, lush wild fig, and green notes of citrusy elderflower growing along forgotten paths, ­kissed by sea salt on a restless wind. The base is ­instinctive—salt-­bleached driftwood, dry cedarwood from ancient groves, and a clean musk that feels both feral and restrained. Petit Sauvage, “Little Wild One,” is more than a ­fragrance. It’s a ­memory. A feeling. Sun-warmed skin, wind-burnt and free. A little wild. Always free. listings.rawTitle: Shower Head+ Hair accessories 1 piece
listings.description: Shower Head+ is Hello Klean’s first intelligent shower filter, combining advanced three-stage filtration with hydropowered technology that tracks water usage and indicates when the filter needs replacing. The KleanShield™ filtration system targets limescale, heavy metals and chlorine before they reach the hair and skin. Independently tested by SGS, it reduces free chlorine by up to 97% over a 10,000-litre service life and maintains at least 82% scale inhibition across 8,000 litres. HydroTrack™ technology measures actual water consumption rather than estimating filter life based on time. The SmartRefill™ indicator signals when a filter replacement is due, while the SmartHeat™ light alerts users when the water temperature reaches 42°C to help protect the hair and skin barrier from excessive heat. Powered entirely by water flow, Shower Head+ requires no batteries or charging and connects to the Hello Klean app (iOS) in seconds. Specially designed micro-nozzles intensify the water flow while reducing consumption by 25%. Installation takes less than a minute, requires no tools and is compatible with 98% of showers. The brushed-metal finish features multi-layer metallised plating and a PVD coating for enhanced corrosion resistance and lasting colour depth. A filter set is included, with each set lasting approximately three months. Hello Klean is backed by the BRITA Group.

listings.rawTitle: Scherzo Extrait de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: Developed at 30% concentration, Scherzo Extrait captures the vibrant spirit of the original Eau de Parfum while unveiling a deeper, more intoxicating signature. Bright, luminous sweetness meets newfound richness and warmth, allowing the fragrance to bloom with a more immersive intensity for lasting presence. The fragrance opens with the familiar rush of tangerine and davana, radiating vibrant fruity luminosity. At its heart, delicate peony blooms abundantly alongside crisp pittosporum, while a new dimension begins to emerge: a more sumptuous and velvety rose, enrobed in golden honey and entwined with creamy vanilla for a richer sensuality, its floral radiance enhanced by threads of incense to bring light and vibration. Together, they introduce a magnetic tension, guiding the fragrance towards more mysterious territory. At the base, shimmering oudh unfolds with greater texture, amplified by intensified patchouli and moss. The introduction of smooth amber woods brings warmth and refinement, creating a striking counterpoint to the fragrance's signature sweetness. As these richer notes emerge, they reveal new facets of its character. The result is a fragrance which is radiant yet mysterious, vibrant yet profound, with a more enduring and enveloping trail. listings.description: With Ambre Latte, Jordi Fernandez offers a unique and exquisitely refined take on indulgence.​ The fragrance unfolds in a vaporous cloud of almond milk, delicately infused with roasted tonka bean.​ Indulgence settles in — irresistible yet perfectly controlled — as a luscious dulce de leche caramel melts into the enveloping softness of vanilla, benzoin and white musks. Very soon, the fragrance reveals its duality. Beneath the milky caress emerges an intensely addictive woody-amber alchemy. Ambrofix, Georgywood, Akigalawood and white sandalwood structure the composition, infusing it with depth, sophistication and modernity. They extend the trail with sensual richness, leaving an unforgettable imprint — the perfect balance between gourmandise and addiction. “I envisioned Ambre Latte as a highly addictive overdose of my favorite amber woods wrapped in a delicious swirl of almond milk. Infused with caramel, tonka, vanilla, and benzoin, this creamy haze lends the amber structure an irresistible and unforgettable signature. A fragrance that draws you in… and keeps you close.” – Jordi Fernandez, perfumer

This 6-pack of taper candles combines both, bringing the historic Nazareth fragrance into your home in a particularly elegant form. The warm, indulgent fragrance blends spicy clove with the bittersweet freshness of bitter orange and the soft, creamy warmth of bourbon vanilla. A festive composition that creates an inviting atmosphere as it burns and offers a sophisticated interpretation of classic Christmas notes. The taper candles are crafted at the Trudon factory in Normandy using traditional candle-making expertise passed down through generations. They burn drip- and smoke-free, and their slender silhouette makes them particularly beautiful for use in candleholders on a festively set table, on the mantelpiece, or as a mood-enhancing arrangement. The set contains: 6 Nazareth taper candles

listings.rawTitle: 6 MAD PARFUMEES BLANC 510 NUIT DES GLACES - FIR Candle 380 g
listings.description: Like a winter forest by candlelight: Trudon’s 6-piece set of taper candles brings the iconic winter scent “Fir” into your home in a particularly elegant form, combining festive candlelight with the aromatic freshness of fir needles. “Fir” captures the atmosphere of vast coniferous forests while evoking one of the most beautiful scents of the Christmas season: a freshly decorated Christmas tree. Green, resinous notes of conifers meet the warm depth of myrrh and frankincense absolute. The result is a distinctive composition blending crisp winter air, aromatic wood, and the cozy warmth of a crackling fireplace. These slender taper candles are crafted at the Trudon factory in Normandy using traditional candle-making expertise passed down through generations. Burning without dripping or smoking, they add atmospheric accents to a festive table, a mantelpiece, or a candle arrangement. The set contains: 6 Fir taper candles

listings.rawTitle: Do Son Eau de Parfum - Holiday Edition Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: Between tuberose and a sea breeze: Do Son Eau de Parfum evokes a summer in Vietnam and is released for the holiday season in a limited edition featuring deep black with shimmering gold accents. The fragrance traces its origins to a childhood memory of Yves Coueslant, one of the founders of Diptyque. He spent his summers in Do Son, a coastal town in Vietnam, where the air blended the intense scent of tuberose with the freshness of the sea breeze. From this memory emerged a tribute to a flower that, like almost no other, embodies opulent sensuality. In the Eau de Parfum, the tuberose is intense and beguiling, yet the floral composition gains a surprising lightness through its association with salty sea air. A fragrance that balances lush bloom with airy freshness, personal memory with a distant coastal landscape. For the holidays, Do Son takes on a new look: black wood and golden accents lend the bottle an elegant, festive aura, transforming this iconic fragrance into a special limited edition.

listings.rawTitle: Eau Rose Eau de Parfum - Holiday Edition Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: Rose, but anything but classic: Eau Rose Eau de Parfum celebrates the queen of flowers in all her splendor and is released for the holiday season in a limited edition featuring a black lacquered wooden cap and golden accents. At its heart are two extraordinary rose varieties: absolutes and extracts from Damask and centifolia roses unfold an intense, multifaceted bouquet that balances floral sensuality with natural freshness. Juicy, fruity lychee adds a vibrant accent, while the essence of the Firad rose complements the composition with surprising nuances of chamomile and artichoke. The result is not a classic interpretation of the rose, but a vibrant portrait of the entire bloom—floral and fruity, green and sensual all at once. A fragrance that reimagines the rose and brings out both its familiar and its unusual facets. For the holidays, Eau Rose receives a particularly elegant finish: the black-lacquered wooden cap with shimmering gold details adds a festive touch and transforms the iconic fragrance into a special limited edition.

listings.rawTitle: Orphéon Eau de Parfum - Holiday Edition Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: Paris by night, captured in a fragrance: Orphéon Eau de Parfum evokes a legendary gathering place for the founders of Diptyque and is released for the holiday season in a limited-edition bottle featuring black wood and gold accents. In the 1960s, the Orphéon bar was located just a stone’s throw from the first Diptyque boutique on Boulevard Saint-Germain. It was a place where people gathered, discussed ideas, and spent long evenings among friends. The fragrance translates this vibrant atmosphere into a multi-layered olfactory portrait: The aromatic freshness of juniper berries meets the depth of cedarwood, the warm softness of tonka bean, and the floral richness of jasmine. Woven throughout are memories of tobacco smoke, powdery blush, and polished wood—sensual snapshots of a place closely tied to Diptyque’s history and friendships. For the holiday season, Orphéon is given a packaging design that is as elegant as it is nocturnal: black wood and shimmering gold accents echo the fragrance’s unique character, transforming it into an expressive limited edition.

listings.rawTitle: Set of 5 Eaux de Parfum - Pre-composed Fragrance Discovery Set 37.50 ml
listings.description: Five fragrances, five stories, a journey through the world of Diptyque: This festive Discovery Set brings together five of the Maison’s iconic Eaux de Parfum and invites you to discover a different olfactory facet every day. From sensual florals to aromatic woods and spicy and fruity nuances, the selection takes you on a journey through Diptyque’s multifaceted herbarium. Fleur de Peau is soft and musky; Do Son unfolds the opulent sensuality of tuberose; while Eau Rose reinterprets the rose with fresh, green, and fruity accents. Tam Dao leads the way into a warm, woody fragrance world with sandalwood, and Orphéon evokes the Parisian nightlife of the 1960s with juniper, cedar, tonka bean, and jasmine. The five fragrances are presented in a limited-edition treasure box inspired by the Enchanted Forest of the festive collection. The wooden figurines created by artist Jean-Simon Roch lend the edition its fairy-tale character and make the set a special gift—or an opportunity to discover these iconic fragrances for yourself. The set contains 5 x 7,5 ml:Fleur de Peau Eau de ParfumDo Son Eau de ParfumEau Rose Eau de ParfumTam Dao Eau de ParfumOrphéon Eau de Parfum

listings.rawTitle: Clay Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the earth and the life it sustains, CLAY is the newest eau de parfum from Perfumer H. Created by founder and perfumer Lyn Harris, the fragrance is an exploration of landscape, materiality and light — a scent that captures the raw beauty of the natural world in its most elemental form. At the heart of the fragrance is a baked clay accord, an idea Lyn explored extensively throughout its development. The warmth of charred woods and Sandalwood evokes the soft sweetness of clay, while Ambroxan radiates a distinctive minerality. A touch of Maltol amplifies the impression of clay being fired and baked, bringing depth and texture to the composition. Orange Flower threads through the fragrance, illuminating and energising its structure. "Orange flower. Mandarin. Sandalwood. Cedarwood. Juniper. Birch tar. Musk. Burnt ash. Raw. But the beauty that comes with it. The different colours. It's just endless. You feel at one with the landscape. Clay is my translation of the earth." – Lyn Harris, Perfumer

listings.rawTitle: Re-charge Black Pepper Eau de Parfum Eau de Parfum Men 30 ml

In the heart note, lavandin, black pepper, and pink pepper meet, while vetiver root creates a grounded base. This is joined by a hint of golden shimmering warmth: an interplay of fine musk and soft vanilla reminiscent of cashmere. A composition that harmoniously combines lightness and depth, adventure and security. Pure. Gentle. Soothing. Top notes: Hypnotic cardamom, bergamot.Heart notes: Invigorating black pepper, pink pepper, lavandin.Base notes: Strong cedarwood, vetiver root, musk, vanilla.

Vanilla Smoke offers a deeper, darker rendition of a classic gourmand scent.” ­ Arnaud Winter & Constance Georges-Picot, Perfumers Top notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Birch Heart notes: Cacao Blanc, Cashmere Vanilla, Tonka Bean Base notes: Incense, Peru Balsam, Amber

listings.rawTitle: Veil Soft Focus Setting Spray 90 ml
listings.description: See your skin through a soft-focus lens that lasts all day long. This lightweight spray sets makeup while blurring imperfections. Undetectable on the skin, the ultra-fine and hydrating mist creates a smooth, even and naturally radiant appearance. Its water-resistant properties enhance foundation for maximum staying power, setting it in place for up to 24 hours.

listings.rawTitle: Multi-Biotics Hydrating and Balancing Body Wash Shower Gel 250 ml
listings.description: Thanks to the synergetic effect of pre- and probiotics, this body wash supports the skin's natural microbiome – an important factor for its resilience and health. A plant-based complex of apple, lemon, grape and wheat bran gently cleanses and moisturizes, leaving the skin feeling nourished and supple. The creamy texture is based on mild, plant-based surfactants that do not dry out and create an exceptionally soft, luxurious lather. A pleasant scent completes the care experience and creates a moment of relaxation.

listings.rawTitle: Balancing Body Care Set Bodylotion & Cream 1 piece
listings.description: Body Care Set consisting of three products based on current scientific research that highlights the central importance of the skin microbiome for healthy, balanced skin. The three Multi-Biotics formulas combine prebiotic ingredients that support beneficial skin bacteria with probiotic actives that soothe and restore. This strengthens the skin, provides it with intensive moisture and promotes its natural balance. Packaged in a high-quality, fluffy teddy bag, the set is a stylish companion for radiant, well-protected skin. The set includes: Multi-Biotics Hydrating and Balancing Body Lotion (150ml) Multi-Biotics Hydrating and Balancing Body Wash (250ml) Multi-Biotics Hydrating and Balancing Body Scrub (150ml) Beauty bag with zipper

listings.rawTitle: Body Butter for the Senses Bodylotion & Cream 200 ml
listings.description: Discover a limited-edition fusion of two of Susanne Kaufmann's bestselling products, Body Butter and Bath for the Senses, with the new Body Butter for the Senses.​ Clinically proven to improve skin moisture and inspired by Alpine wellness rituals, this luxuriously rich yet fast-absorbing formula contains 99% ingredients from natural origin that work harmoniously to enhance skin elasticity, protect against dryness and restore the skin to optimal health. Enriched with olive oil for long-lasting hydration, shea butter to help prevent dehydration, and whey powder to support the skin’s natural pH balance. Upon application, this ultra-nourishing blend melts into the skin, imparting a delicately soothing fragrance featuring notes of ylang ylang, patchouli and lavender, while delivering velvety soft, smooth and glowing skin from shoulders-to-toes.​ The Body Butter for the Senses packaging showcases a limited-edition design featuring Susanne Kaufmann’s signature bird emblem in golden yellow holding a sprig of rosemary in its beak. This design is a celebration of the iconic Bath for the Senses and represents the harmony and elevated experience that both the Body Butter and Bath for the Senses embody.

listings.rawTitle: Neroli Oranger Eau de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: The purity of orange blossom is the starting point for MATIERE PREMIERE's NEROLI ORANGER eau de parfum. As the brand suggests, the House takes great care of its ingredients, drawing the fresh, vibrant heart of this fragrance from Italian bergamot and neroli oil from Lebanon. Floral Musk and Ylang Ylang from the Comoros underline its floral facet.

listings.rawTitle: Parisian Musc Eau de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: PARISIAN MUSC is an urban, modern woody musk built around precious Ambrette Seed from Peru, the only vegetal musk in the Perfumers' palette. Cedar Oil brings out a woody long lasting trail. The musky facet is amplified by Ambrettolide and Ambroxan. A fig leaf note highlights the vegetal character.

listings.rawTitle: Bois d'Ebène Eau de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: A patchwork of dark woods from all over the world, BOIS D'EBENE is an elegant and long-lasting woody fragrance. Guaiac Wood Paraguay is reinforced by Indonesian Patchouli and Indian Cypriol. Cabreuva Oil from Brazil gives a malty touch, while Juniper berry highlights the spicy fresh woody character.

listings.rawTitle: Santal Austral Eau de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: SANTAL AUSTRAL is built around organic Sandalwood Oil from Australia. Founder and Perfumer Aurélien Guichard chose to highlight the creamy, velvety facet with an almond milk note and Iris Absolute Tuscany. Benzoin Absolute Laos and Tonka Bean Absolute Venezuela bring a long-lasting comfort and addictiveness.

listings.rawTitle: Encens Suave Eau de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: ENCENS SUAVE is built around a Somalian Incense Resin, magnified by Labdanum Absolute Andalusia and Benzoin Absolute Laos. A unique accord with Coffee Extraction Venezuela and Vanilla Absolute Madagascar brings warmth and addictiveness to the incense core.

listings.rawTitle: Radical Rose Eau de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: RADICAL ROSE contains the highest dosage of Rose Centifolia Absolute, extracted from flowers grown in organic farming by MATIERE PREMIERE in the Grasse region. Patchouli and pepper berries accentuate the bright, spicy facet, while Patchouli and Labdanum Absolute highlight the dark, woody facet of the rose.

listings.rawTitle: Falcon Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: FALCON LEATHER is Inspired by Falconers’ leather gloves, and built around Birch Tar, used for hundreds of years to tan leather. Its power is revealed from the start thanks to Saffron. Labdanum & Benzoin highlight both the full-grain side and the soft, suede side of leather.

listings.rawTitle: French Flower Eau de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the intoxicating smell of a Tuberose field at night, FRENCH FLOWER is built around an overdose of Tuberose, organically grown by MATIERE PREMIERE in the South of France. Ginger amplifies its whiteness. Green Tea Leaf Oil and a Green Pear accord underline its vegetal character.

listings.rawTitle: Crystal Saffron Eau de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: Edgy and soft, CRYSTAL SAFFRON highlights the addictive contradictions of its main ingredient, Saffron Oil Greece, considered to be the most qualitative saffron in the world. Habanolide Musk amplifies the contemporary and genderless character, Ambroxan highlights the comfortable facet. Incense Oil Somalia accentuates the projection and brings texture to the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: XJV CORO Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: Coro is a scent with an invigorating energy. Its vibe is that of an early riser, a go-getter who is ready to take on the world. listings.description: A light, beginner-friendly self-tanning mousse specially developed for medium to dark skin tones and those seeking a subtle, sun-kissed tan. The airy, transparent formula melts effortlessly into the skin for an even, natural-looking tan: without streaks, stickiness, or orange tones. Ideal for those new to self-tanning or anyone looking for a soft colour boost, this mousse develops within 4 to 8 hours and lasts up to 7 days. Infused with skin-loving ingredients like hyaluronic acid, aloe vera, collagen, and antioxidant-rich blueberry extract to nourish, protect, and leave skin smooth and tanned. Fragrance-free, fast-drying, and transfer-proof, so your sheets and clothes stay clean. Vegan, cruelty-free, and suitable for all skin types, including sensitive.

listings.description: A soft, stretchable applicator designed to apply self-tanner evenly to hard-to-reach areas like the back and shoulders, without help. The ROQUEBRUN. Back Applicator ensures a smooth, streak-free tan from top to bottom, making it the perfect companion to your full-body tanning routine.

listings.rawTitle: Back Exfoliator Body brushes 1 piece
listings.description: A flexible, double-handled exfoliating strap designed to reach those hard-to-get areas like your back and shoulders. The ROQUEBRUN. Back Exfoliator buffs away dead skin cells, helps unclog pores, and preps the skin for a smooth, even self-tan, without needing assistance.

listings.rawTitle: Father Figure Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: A provacative, green fig fragrance. Commanding yet tender at the same time. Rooted in lushness, FATHER FIGURE is a vivid green fragrance that captures the intimate feeling of cool. Opening with fleshy fig and dewy cassis, then folding into a creamy sandalwood, orris root, vanilla madagascar, FATHER FIGURE is layered and vibrant. Skin musks and sheer patchouli add intimacy and sensuality."This fragrance is inspired by hidden gardens. There is a contrast between the vivid greenness and something more skin-like. The milky nectar of fig compliments buttery suede qualities of orris to create a naturally sensual effect." – Frank Voelkl, PerfumerTop notes: Waterlily, Lush Fig, Cassis BudsHeart notes: Orris Root, Iris Flower, Jasmine DewBase notes: Skin Musks, Vanilla Madagascar, Patchouli Leaf, Sandalwood

listings.rawTitle: Summer Rain Room Spray 250 ml
listings.description: Diffusing throughout every corner of your home, experience the signature fragrances from Byredo in fresh designs and reimagined formats. Transform the atmosphere of your space instantly with the generous 250ml Room Spray. Housed in sleek black glass with our signature white label, just a few quick sprays envelop the furthest corners of your living room, bedroom, or entryway with the scent of Summer Rain. A sudden downpour, heavy drops sizzling on sun-warmed earth. A refreshing parenthesis on a summer day representing the restorative power of nature. Opening notes of basil and spearmint bring a fresh breeze, with vibrant green fig and ginger. As rain fades, sandalwood and tonka settle, grounding the composition.

Designed with high-performance heat and ceramic attachments, the Aire 360 air styler blowout kit styles bouncy blowouts and lasting curls with nothing but air. Powered by T3 Aire 360 Technology, superior airflow wraps hair effortlessly to style blowout curls with zero heat damage,* and extra-long ceramic curling attachments harness high-performance heat to deliver long-lasting results. The custom-designed oval brush features SmoothGrip bristles and a ceramic surface for pro-level smoothing and shaping. And the SoftAire® drying concentrator delivers fast-yet-gentle drying that helps protect hair's natural moisture. All attachments pair with the Aire 360 base, engineered with a smart microchip for digital heat control and a high-speed AireX motor for the fastest drying yet. Fast, easy styling that's gentle on hair. Big-time body and shine. Blowout curls that defy gravity. *Based on a third-party study in which a tensile strength test showed no mechanical damage to the hair when using the T3 Aire 360 curling attachments set on the highest temperature and highest velocity on hair in both a dry state and a 20% wet state.

listings.rawTitle: OH MY CHAÏ Extrait de Parfum Unisex 15 ml
listings.description: A woody, spicy, enveloping warmth. A fragrance that pulses between embers and velvet, bold yet tender. Perfumer Margaux Le Paih-Guérin reinvented the spirit of Christmas through a spiced and milky Chai latte, a touch of mandarin, deeply comforting, and hints of wood fire. A warm, sparkling opening of cardamom and cinnamon wraps itself in a creamy veil. Contrasts: the resinous smoke of fir blending with milky softness.

listings.rawTitle: IT'S A MATCH-A Extrait de Parfum Unisex 15 ml
listings.description: A meeting between frothy green tea and a generously filled brunch table. Perfumer Amélie Bourgeois twisted matcha into a milky, green accord, surprising and ultra-gourmand. A soft, sweet opening of warm pancake and juicy blueberry melts into the roundness of vanilla and crunchy pistachio. Contrasts: the vegetal freshness of matcha tea meets the creamy smoothness of warm milk. A suave veil, more softness than strictness: sweet, tender, comforting.

listings.rawTitle: Afterglow Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: The moment hangs in the air. It’s heavy and golden, buzzing with the tension of a connection just made. A spark that’s felt from the flush in your cheeks to the flutter in your stomach. The Afterglow fragrance captures the thrill: bright citrus and juicy apricot meet creamy coconut for a sunlit, almost electric opening. As it deepens, warm vanilla and lavender milk melt into spiced sandalwood and soft woods, echoing the lingering warmth of skin-to-skin nearness. A mirage so intoxicating, you hope it never fades. “I was inspired by the spark of a first connection. The kind that lingers in the air like static. It’s warm and alive, a mix of anticipation and ease. That moment of charged stillness that's soft and intimate is what I wanted to capture.” – Clement Gavarry, Perfumer Top notes: Citrus Splash, Apricot Skin, Coconut FoamHeart notes: Lavender Milk, Ambrette, Vanilla PlanifoliaBase notes: Sandalwood, Amber, Cashmere Woods

At the same time, it gives the skin an instant energy boost for a radiant, healthy complexion. “A new addition to the Zelens Powers vitamin alphabet, Power B is suitable for normal as well as oily, stressed and problem skin, due to a combination of B vitamins such as niacinamide (B3), pantothenic acid (B5) – and vitamin B12, which gives it the beautiful pink colour.” – Dr. Marko Lens, Founder Dermatologically tested. The complexion appears smoother, plumper, and visibly strengthened. “I am proud of our pioneering use of vitamin D in skincare. Power D has so many benefits for the skin, since it helps strengthen the skin barrier, build skin’s resilience and protect it against external factors and stress. Our new formula is a much stronger concentrate compared to the previous formulation.” – Dr. Marko Lens, Founder Dermatologically tested and recommended for normal to dry, sensitive, or weakened skin.

An intimate blend of musk and amber, softened by the suggestion of old books through earthy moss and dry vanilla. Seeking to capture all of Jane's favourite scents and chic sensuality, L'Air de Rien searches for the comfort of a lovers embrace, watching dust dance in the light as you lay entwined. listings.rawTitle: Dance Amongst The Lace Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Bracing and refreshing, this Eau de Parfum pays homage to the humble road-side greenery of cow parsley in a contemporary aromatic fragrance.
